+      fun h => (hcut r hr hrT).2 (hq.symm.trans (congrArg some h))⟩
+  obtain ⟨T, hT, htRun, htCut, _, htHeads⟩ := b2b_trial_run MV MI MP x u b ti si sv hi his hv
+  have hguard (t : ℕ) (htt : t < T) (q : Σ j, b2b_testState MV MI j)
+      (hq : ((b2b_testTM MV MI MP).runFrom c t).state = some q) :
+      b2b_bodyRedirect MV MI .test q = none := by
+    rcases q with ⟨j, q⟩
+    cases j <;> try rfl
+    cases q with
+    | left => rfl
+    | read => rfl
+    | done b' =>
+      exact False.elim ((htCut t htt).2 b' hq)
+  have hprefix (t : ℕ) (htt : t ≤ T) : H.runFrom d t =
+      ((b2b_testTM MV MI MP).runFrom c t).mapState (Sigma.mk B2bBodyPhase.test) := by
+    refine MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn (b2b_testTM MV MI MP) H
+      ⟨(fun q => (⟨B2bBodyPhase.test, q⟩ : Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j)),
+        by intro q q' h; simpa using h⟩
+      (fun q => b2b_bodyRedirect MV MI .test q = none) ?_ c t ?_
+    · intro q hq inp work
+      simp [H, b2b_bodyTM, phaseHostTM, hq, b2b_bodyPhases]
+    · intro r hr q hq
+      exact hguard r (by omega) q hq
+  cases b with
+  | true =>
+    refine ⟨T, hT, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · rw [hprefix T le_rfl, htRun]
+      rfl
+    · intro t hpos hlt
+      rw [hprefix t (by omega)]
+      have ha := (htCut t hlt).1 hpos
+      have he := (htCut t hlt).2 true
+      simpa [a, e, Cfg.mapState, Option.map_eq_some_iff] using And.intro ha he
+    · intro t ht j
+      rw [hprefix t ht]
+      exact htHeads t ht j
+  | false =>
+    have hp := phaseHostTM_run (b2b_bodyPhases MV MI MP)
+      ⟨.test, ⟨.anchor, ()⟩⟩ (b2b_bodyRedirect MV MI) .test c c' T htRun
+      ⟨.verdict, B2bVerdictState.done false⟩ rfl ⟨.clear, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ rfl hguard
+    let s := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP (⟨B2bBodyPhase.clear, SweepPhase.sweep⟩ :
+      Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j) (x := x) 1 u (x ++ u) [] 0 0
+    have hmid : H.runFrom d (T + 1) = s := hp.2
+    obtain ⟨S, hS, hsRun, hsCut, hsHeads⟩ := b2b_reject_suffix MV MI MP x u v hsucc hlen
+    refine ⟨(T + 1) + S, by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hmid, hsRun]
+      rfl
+    · intro t hpos hlt
+      by_cases hpre : t < T
+      · rw [hprefix t (by omega)]
+        have ha := (htCut t hpre).1 hpos
+        have he := (htCut t hpre).2 true
+        simpa [a, e, Cfg.mapState, Option.map_eq_some_iff] using And.intro ha he
+      · by_cases htEq : t = T
+        · subst t
+          rw [hprefix T le_rfl, htRun]
+          simp [a, e, b2b_trialCfg, Cfg.mapState, Cfg.init]
+          constructor <;> intro hh <;> cases hh
+        · have heq : H.runFrom d t = H.runFrom s (t - (T + 1)) := by
+            conv_lhs => rw [show t = (T + 1) + (t - (T + 1)) by omega,
+              MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hmid]
+          rw [heq]
+          exact hsCut _ (by omega)
+    · intro t ht j
+      by_cases hpre : t ≤ T
+      · rw [hprefix t hpre]
+        exact htHeads t hpre j
+      · have heq : H.runFrom d t = H.runFrom s (t - (T + 1)) := by
+          conv_lhs => rw [show t = (T + 1) + (t - (T + 1)) by omega,
+            MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hmid]
+        rw [heq]
+        exact (hsHeads _ (by omega) j).trans (by omega)
+
+/-- The host's answer phase emits its singleton and halts in two steps,
+leaving all work heads fixed throughout.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Transfer the existing answer contract into its unredirected
+host phase. The two emission actions have zero movement on every work tape,
+so their three prefix configurations have the same work heads. -/
+private theorem b2b_finish_answer (MV MI MP : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (b : Bool)
+    (c : Cfg (b2b_tapeCount MV.k MI.k MP.k + 1) Bool (Fin 2) x)
+    (hc : c.state = some 0) :
+    let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+    let d := c.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer b))
+    (H.runFrom d 2).state = none ∧ (H.runFrom d 2).output = c.output ++ [b] ∧
+      ∀ r ≤ 2, (H.runFrom d r).workTapePos = c.workTapePos := by
+  classical
+  dsimp only
+  let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+  let M := b2b_answerTM (b2b_tapeCount MV.k MI.k MP.k + 1) b
+  have hp (t : ℕ) : H.runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer b))) t =
+      (M.runFrom c t).mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer b)) := by
+    refine MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn M H
+      ⟨(fun q => (⟨B2bHostPhase.answer b, q⟩ : Σ j, b2b_hostState MV MI MP j)),
+        by intro q q' h
+           exact @sigma_mk_injective B2bHostPhase (b2b_hostState MV MI MP)
+             (B2bHostPhase.answer b) q q' h⟩ (fun _ => True) ?_ c t (by intros; trivial)
+    intro q _ inp work
+    rfl
+  obtain ⟨hh, ho⟩ := b2b_answer_run b c hc
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [hp]
+    simp only [Cfg.mapState, hh, Option.map_none]
+  · rw [hp]
+    exact ho
+  · intro r hr
+    rw [hp]
+    change (M.runFrom c r).workTapePos = c.workTapePos
+    have h1 : M.runFrom c 1 = { c with state := some 1, output := c.output ++ [b] } := by
+      simp [M, b2b_answerTM, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.step, hc,
+        FinTM.emitAction, Action.apply]
+    interval_cases r
+    · rfl
+    · rw [h1]
+    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', h1]
+      simp [M, b2b_answerTM, MultiTapeTM.step, FinTM.emitAction, Action.apply]
+
+/-- After counter exhaustion the host reuses the shared trial and emits its
+answer. The counter tape is arbitrary and stays at its fixed origin.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Embed the shared trial along the first-tape bank, apply the
+public phase-host dispatch at its first verdict, and invoke the proved final
+answer phase. Selected heads follow the shared trial and the counter head is
+fixed by the embedding frame. The answer preserves those same heads. -/
+private theorem b2b_finish_last (MV MI MP : FinTM Bool) (x u : List Bool)
+    (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (b : Bool) (ti si sv : ℕ)
+    (hi : MI.ComputesInTime x x ti) (his : MI.tm.spaceUsed (MI.tm.initCfg x) ti ≤ si)
+    (hv : LogProg.CleanRun (LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀)
+      (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) (x ++ u) b sv) :
+    let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+    let c := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP (⟨B2bBodyPhase.test, ⟨B2bTestPhase.anchor, ()⟩⟩ :
+      Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j) (x := x) 1 u [] [] 0 0
+    let d := (counterLoopCfg (some .done) c ct 0).mapState
+      (fun _ => (⟨B2bHostPhase.last, ⟨B2bTestPhase.anchor, ()⟩⟩ : Σ j, b2b_hostState MV MI MP j))
+    ∃ T : ℕ, (H.runFrom d T).state = none ∧ (H.runFrom d T).output = [b] ∧
+      ∀ r ≤ T, ∀ j, |(H.runFrom d r).workTapePos j| ≤
+        (x.length + u.length + sv + si + 1 : ℕ) := by
+  classical
+  dsimp only
+  let K := b2b_tapeCount MV.k MI.k MP.k
+  let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+  let M := b2b_testTM MV MI MP
+  let c := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP (⟨B2bTestPhase.anchor, ()⟩ : Σ j, b2b_testState MV MI j)
+    (x := x) 1 u [] [] 0 0
+  let c' := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP (⟨B2bTestPhase.verdict, B2bVerdictState.done b⟩ :
+    Σ j, b2b_testState MV MI j) (x := x) 1 u (x ++ u) [] 0 0
+  let E := embedEmitTM Fin.castSuccEmb M
+  let d := embedEmitCfg Fin.castSuccEmb (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) [] c
+  let d' := embedEmitCfg Fin.castSuccEmb (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) [] c'
+  obtain ⟨T, _, hrun, hcut, _, hheads⟩ := b2b_trial_run MV MI MP x u b ti si sv hi his hv
+  have ep (t : ℕ) : E.runFrom d t =
+      embedEmitCfg Fin.castSuccEmb (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) [] (M.runFrom c t) :=
+    embedEmitTM_runFrom Fin.castSuccEmb M (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) [] c t
+  have he : E.runFrom d T = d' := by rw [ep, hrun]
+  have hp := phaseHostTM_run (b2b_hostPhases MV MI MP)
+    ⟨.setup, Sum.inl (.init MP.tm.q₀)⟩ (b2b_hostRedirect MV MI MP) .last d d' T he
+    ⟨.verdict, B2bVerdictState.done b⟩ rfl ⟨.answer b, (0 : Fin 2)⟩ rfl (by
+      intro t ht q hq
+      rw [ep] at hq
+      change (M.runFrom c t).state = some q at hq
+      rcases q with ⟨j, q⟩
+      cases j <;> try rfl
+      cases q with
+      | left => rfl
+      | read => rfl
+      | done b' => exact False.elim ((hcut t ht).2 b' hq))
+  let ans := d'.mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 2))
+  have hans := b2b_finish_answer MV MI MP b ans rfl
+  have hfinal : H.runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.last)) ((T + 1) + 2) =
+      H.runFrom (ans.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer b))) 2 := by
+    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp.2, b2b_dispatch_retag]
+    rfl
+  have hlast : Fin.last K ∉ Set.range (Fin.castSuccEmb : Fin K ↪ Fin (K + 1)) := by
+    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
+    exact Fin.castSucc_ne_last i hi
+  have hb (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) (j : Fin (K + 1)) :
+      |(E.runFrom d t).workTapePos j| ≤ (x.length + u.length + sv + si + 1 : ℕ) := by
+    rw [ep]
+    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
+    · have hf := ((embedEmitTM_frame Fin.castSuccEmb M (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) []
+        (M.runFrom c t) 0).1 (Fin.last K) hlast).2
+      have hf' : (embedEmitCfg Fin.castSuccEmb (fun _ => ct) (fun _ => 0) []
+          (M.runFrom c t)).workTapePos (Fin.last K) = 0 := by
+        simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] using hf
+      rw [hf']; positivity
+    · rw [show i.castSucc = Fin.castSuccEmb i from rfl, embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
+      exact hheads t ht i
+  have hbEnd (j : Fin (K + 1)) : |ans.workTapePos j| ≤
+      (x.length + u.length + sv + si + 1 : ℕ) := by
+    have hh := hb T le_rfl j
+    rw [he] at hh
+    exact hh
+  change ∃ T', (H.runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.last)) T').state = none ∧
+    (H.runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.last)) T').output = [b] ∧
+    ∀ r ≤ T', ∀ j, |(H.runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.last)) r).workTapePos j| ≤ _
+  refine ⟨(T + 1) + 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · rw [hfinal]
+    exact hans.1
+  · rw [hfinal, hans.2.1]
+    rfl
+  · intro r hr j
+    by_cases hpre : r ≤ T
+    · rw [hp.1 r hpre]
+      exact hb r hpre j
+    · have heq : H.runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.last)) r =
+          H.runFrom (ans.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer b))) (r - (T + 1)) := by
+        conv_lhs => rw [show r = (T + 1) + (r - (T + 1)) by omega,
+          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp.2, b2b_dispatch_retag]
+        rfl
+      rw [heq, hans.2.2 _ (by omega)]
+      exact hbEnd j
+
+/-- The remaining certificate search starts at the established setup seam and
+halts with its single decision bit, within fixed windows independent of the
+number of counted trials.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Prove one shared test contract by composing the identity
+capture, native rewind, framed append copy, captured virtual verifier call,
+and verdict reader through the existing phase host. On rejection clear the
+buffer and increment the certificate. Apply the counter loop's escape or done
+contract along the existing certificate orbit, using classically chosen exact
+round durations. On exhaustion reuse the test for the final certificate,
+including the sole empty certificate when the width is zero. Compose with the
+answer emitter. The counter/body trajectory clauses and the shared test's
+fixed windows give the radius below, without any factor counting trials.
+
+Status: proved (B2b fill, delivery 3). Setup is `b2b_setup_run`; this helper
+covers the shared trial (`b2b_trial_run`), the counted loop, the final trial and
+the answer. -/
+private theorem b2b_search_contract (Q e cV cI : ℕ) (V : Language Bool)
+    (MV MI MP : FinTM Bool)
+    (hV : ∀ y : List Bool,
+      LogProg.CleanRun (LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀)
+        (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y
+        (MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) y) (cV * (y.length ^ e + 1)))
+    (hI : MI.ComputesFunInTime id (fun n => cI * (n + 1)))
+    (hIs : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), MI.tm.spaceUsed (MI.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ cI)
+    (x : List Bool) :
+    let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+    let d := b2b_setupCfg MV MI MP (⟨B2bHostPhase.loop, CounterLoopState.dec .run⟩ :
+      Σ j, b2b_hostState MV MI MP j) (x := x) 1 (List.replicate Q false) (List.replicate Q true)
+    ∃ t : ℕ, (H.runFrom d t).state = none ∧
+      (H.runFrom d t).output =
+        [MultiTapeTM.indicator {z : List Bool | ∃ u, u.length = Q ∧ z ++ u ∈ V} x] ∧
+      ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(H.runFrom d u).workTapePos j| ≤
+        (x.length + Q + cV * ((x.length + Q) ^ e + 1) + cI + 1 : ℕ) := by
+  classical
+  dsimp only
+  let K := b2b_tapeCount MV.k MI.k MP.k
+  let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+  let B := b2b_bodyTM MV MI MP
+  let a : Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j := ⟨.test, ⟨.anchor, ()⟩⟩
+  let e' : Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j := ⟨.test, ⟨.verdict, B2bVerdictState.done true⟩⟩
+  let G (u : List Bool) := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP a (x := x) 1 u [] [] 0 0
+  let A (u : List Bool) := b2b_trialCfg MV MI MP e' (x := x) 1 u (x ++ u) [] 0 0
+  let word (r : ℕ) := enumWord Q r
+  let yes (r : ℕ) := MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) (x ++ word r)
+  let d := 2 ^ Q - 1
+  let sv := cV * ((x.length + Q) ^ e + 1)
+  let W := x.length + Q + sv + cI + 1
+  let init := G (List.replicate Q false)
+  let w := List.replicate Q true
+  let dc := counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) init (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0
+  have hpow : 1 ≤ 2 ^ Q := Nat.one_le_two_pow
+  have hclean (r : ℕ) : LogProg.CleanRun (LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀)
+      (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) (x ++ word r) (yes r) sv := by
+    simpa only [yes, word, List.length_append, Meyer.length_enumWord] using hV (x ++ enumWord Q r)
+  have hround (r : ℕ) (hr : r < d) : ∃ T : ℕ, 0 < T ∧
+      B.runFrom (G (word r)) T = (if yes r then A (word r) else G (word (r + 1))) ∧
+      (∀ t, 0 < t → t < T → ∃ q,
+        (B.runFrom (G (word r)) t).state = some q ∧ q ≠ a ∧ q ≠ e') ∧
+      ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ j, |(B.runFrom (G (word r)) t).workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
+    have hinc := Meyer.incFixed_enumWord Q r (by dsimp [d] at hr; omega)
+    have hh := b2b_round_run MV MI MP x (word r) (word (r + 1)) (yes r)
+      (cI * (x.length + 1)) cI sv (hI x) (hIs x _) (hclean r) hinc
+      (by simp [word])
+    simpa only [B, G, A, a, e', W, word, Meyer.length_enumWord] using hh
+  let duration (r : Fin d) : ℕ := Classical.choose (hround r r.isLt)
+  have duration_spec (r : Fin d) := Classical.choose_spec (hround r r.isLt)
+  have index_inj {r s : Fin d} (hc : G (word r) = G (word s)) : r = s := by
+    have hw : word r = word s := by
+      apply List.ext_getElem?
+      intro n
+      have he := congrFun (congrFun (congrArg Cfg.workTapes hc)
+        (b2b_wordTape MV.k MI.k MP.k 0)) (n : ℤ)
+      simpa [G, b2b_trialCfg, b2b_wordTape, FinTM.bufferTape] using he
+    apply Fin.ext
+    have hn := congrArg TimeHierarchy.ctrVal hw
+    rw [Meyer.ctrVal_enumWord Q r (by have := r.isLt; dsimp [d] at this; omega),
+      Meyer.ctrVal_enumWord Q s (by have := s.isLt; dsimp [d] at this; omega)] at hn
+    exact hn
+  let τ (c : Cfg K Bool (Σ j, b2b_bodyState MV MI j) x) : ℕ :=
+    if h : ∃ r : Fin d, c = G (word r) then duration (Classical.choose h) else 0
+  have τ_eq (r : Fin d) : τ (G (word r)) = duration r := by
+    have hx : ∃ s : Fin d, G (word r) = G (word s) := ⟨r, rfl⟩
+    dsimp only [τ]
+    rw [dif_pos hx]
+    exact congrArg duration (index_inj (Classical.choose_spec hx)).symm
+  have round_spec (r : ℕ) (hr : r < d) :
+      0 < τ (G (word r)) ∧
+      B.runFrom (G (word r)) (τ (G (word r))) =
+        (if yes r then A (word r) else G (word (r + 1))) ∧
+      (∀ t, 0 < t → t < τ (G (word r)) → ∃ q,
+        (B.runFrom (G (word r)) t).state = some q ∧ q ≠ a ∧ q ≠ e') ∧
+      ∀ t ≤ τ (G (word r)), ∀ j,
+        |(B.runFrom (G (word r)) t).workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
+    have hh := duration_spec ⟨r, hr⟩
+    have he := τ_eq ⟨r, hr⟩
+    simpa only [he] using hh
+  have orbit (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ d) (hn : ∀ s < r, yes s = false) :
+      counterLoopOrbit B τ init r = G (word r) := by
+    induction r with
+    | zero =>
+      have hz := b2b_certificate_orbit Q 0 (by omega)
+      simpa only [counterLoopOrbit, Function.iterate_zero_apply, init, word] using congrArg G hz
+    | succ r ih =>
+      have hrd : r < d := by omega
+      change (fun c => B.runFrom c (τ c))^[r + 1] init = _
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+      change B.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r) (τ (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r)) = _
+      rw [ih (by omega) (fun s hs => hn s (by omega)), (round_spec r hrd).2.1,
+        hn r (by omega)]
+      rfl
+  have hstart : b2b_setupCfg MV MI MP
+      (⟨B2bHostPhase.loop, CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run⟩ : Σ j, b2b_hostState MV MI MP j)
+      (x := x) 1 (List.replicate Q false) w = dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop) := by
+    dsimp only [dc]
+    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
+    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
+    · funext j z
+      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
+      · simp [Cfg.mapState, b2b_setupCfg, G, init, b2b_trialCfg, Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last _)]
+      · simp [Cfg.mapState, b2b_setupCfg, G, init, b2b_trialCfg, Fin.castSucc_inj, Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
+    · funext j
+      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j <;> simp [Cfg.mapState, G, init, b2b_trialCfg, b2b_setupCfg, Cfg.init]
+  rw [hstart]
+  change ∃ t, (H.runFrom (dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop)) t).state = none ∧
+    (H.runFrom (dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop)) t).output =
+      [MultiTapeTM.indicator {z : List Bool | ∃ u, u.length = Q ∧ z ++ u ∈ V} x] ∧
+    ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(H.runFrom (dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop)) u).workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ)
+  by_cases hex : ∃ r < d, x ++ word r ∈ V
+  · let r₀ := Nat.find hex
+    have hr₀ : r₀ < d := (Nat.find_spec hex).1
+    have hy₀ : yes r₀ = true := by
+      have hm : x ++ word r₀ ∈ V := (Nat.find_spec hex).2
+      simp [yes, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hm]
+    have hbefore (r : ℕ) (hr : r < r₀) : yes r = false := by
+      have hn : x ++ word r ∉ V := by
+        intro hm
+        exact Nat.find_min hex hr ⟨by omega, hm⟩
+      simp [yes, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hn]
+    have horbit (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ r₀) : counterLoopOrbit B τ init r = G (word r) :=
+      orbit r (by omega) (fun s hs => hbefore s (by omega))
+    have hend : counterLoopOrbit B τ init (r₀ + 1) = A (word r₀) := by
+      change (fun c => B.runFrom c (τ c))^[r₀ + 1] init = _
+      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+      change B.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r₀) (τ (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r₀)) = _
+      rw [horbit r₀ le_rfl, (round_spec r₀ hr₀).2.1, hy₀]
+      rfl
+    let T := (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (r₀ + 1), τ (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r)) +
+      counterOverhead w (r₀ + 1)
+    have hl := counterLoopTM_run_escape B a e' (by simp [a, e']; intro hh; cases hh) τ init
+      w (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0 (by intros; simp) r₀
+      (by simpa only [w, b2b_counter_value] using hr₀) (by
+        intro r hr
+        rw [horbit r hr]
+        exact ⟨rfl, (round_spec r (by omega)).1, (round_spec r (by omega)).2.2.1⟩)
+      (by rw [hend]; rfl) T rfl
+    let L := counterLoopTM B a (some e')
+    let ct := fun q => if (0 : ℤ) ≤ q ∧ q < 0 + (w.length : ℤ)
+      then FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w (r₀ + 1)) (q - 0) else FinTM.bufferTape w q
+    let c' := counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.escape) (A (word r₀)) ct 0
+    have he : L.runFrom dc T = c' := by
+      simpa only [hend] using hl.1
+    have hb (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) (j : Fin (K + 1)) :
+        |(L.runFrom dc t).workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
+      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
+      · have hh : (L.runFrom dc t).workTapePos (Fin.last K) ∈ Finset.Icc (-1) (Q : ℤ) := by
+          simpa only [w, List.length_replicate, zero_sub, zero_add] using hl.2.2.1 t ht
+        obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hh
+        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by dsimp [W]; omega, by dsimp [W]; omega⟩
+      · obtain ⟨r, u, hr, hpos⟩ := hl.2.2.2 t ht
+        change |((counterLoopTM B a (some e')).runFrom dc t).workTapePos i.castSucc| ≤ _
+        rw [hpos i]
+        rcases hr with ⟨hr, hu⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
+        · rw [horbit r hr] at hu ⊢
+          exact (round_spec r (by omega)).2.2.2 u hu i
+        · rw [hend]
+          simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, A, b2b_trialCfg]
+          simp only [ite_self, abs_zero]
+          positivity
+    have hp := phaseHostTM_run (b2b_hostPhases MV MI MP)
+      ⟨.setup, Sum.inl (.init MP.tm.q₀)⟩ (b2b_hostRedirect MV MI MP) .loop dc c' T he
+      CounterLoopState.escape rfl ⟨.answer true, (0 : Fin 2)⟩ rfl (by
+        intro t ht q hq
+        cases q with
+        | dec q => rfl
+        | body q => rfl
+        | done => exact False.elim ((hl.2.1 t ht).1 hq)
+        | escape => exact False.elim ((hl.2.1 t ht).2 hq))
+    let ans := c'.mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 2))
+    have hans := b2b_finish_answer MV MI MP true ans rfl
+    have hfinal : H.runFrom (dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop)) ((T + 1) + 2) =
+        H.runFrom (ans.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer true))) 2 := by
+      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp.2, b2b_dispatch_retag]
+      rfl
+    have hbEnd (j : Fin (K + 1)) : |ans.workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
+      have hh := hb T le_rfl j
+      rw [he] at hh
+      exact hh
+    have hm : ∃ u, u.length = Q ∧ x ++ u ∈ V :=
+      ⟨word r₀, Meyer.length_enumWord Q r₀, (Nat.find_spec hex).2⟩
+    refine ⟨(T + 1) + 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · rw [hfinal]
+      exact hans.1
+    · rw [hfinal, hans.2.1]
+      simp [ans, c', counter_cfg_eq, A, b2b_trialCfg, Cfg.mapState,
+        MultiTapeTM.indicator, hm]
+    · intro t ht j
+      by_cases hpre : t ≤ T
+      · rw [hp.1 t hpre]
+        exact hb t hpre j
+      · have htEq : H.runFrom (dc.mapState (Sigma.mk B2bHostPhase.loop)) t =
+            H.runFrom (ans.mapState (Sigma.mk (B2bHostPhase.answer true))) (t - (T + 1)) := by
+          conv_lhs => rw [show t = (T + 1) + (t - (T + 1)) by omega,
+            MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp.2, b2b_dispatch_retag]
+          rfl
+        rw [htEq, hans.2.2 _ (by omega)]
+        exact hbEnd j
+  · have hno (r : ℕ) (hr : r < d) : yes r = false := by
+      have hn : x ++ word r ∉ V := fun hm => hex ⟨r, hr, hm⟩
+      simp [yes, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hn]
+    have horbit (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ d) : counterLoopOrbit B τ init r = G (word r) :=
+      orbit r hr (fun s hs => hno s (by omega))
+    let T := (∑ r ∈ Finset.range d, τ (counterLoopOrbit B τ init r)) + counterOverhead w (d + 1)
+    have hl := counterLoopTM_run_done B a (some e') τ init w (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0
+      (by intros; simp) d (b2b_counter_value Q) (by
+        intro r hr
+        rw [horbit r (by omega), horbit (r + 1) (by omega)]

+/-- The assembled host decides the exact certificate predicate within fixed windows.
+
+**Proof sketch.** First apply the five setup rows: capture the unary polynomial,
+virtually rewind it, copy it to the last tape, overflow-increment the certificate
+to zeros, and rewind the native input. For the shared test, capture the identity
+call, rewind, apply `copyTM_run_ofCfg` and `b2b_buffer_concat`, run the verifier
+under `vhostEmitTM`, and erase/read the captured bit. Use `exists_first_halt` at
+each halting source, the returning embeddings for live exits, and `phaseHostTM_run`
+with `b2b_dispatch_retag` for every dispatch. One round lemma covers both verdicts;
+on rejection, clear the buffer and apply the framed increment. Choose the exact
+round durations classically. Apply `counterLoopTM_run_escape` to the first
+accepting counted round, or `counterLoopTM_run_done` and the final shared test.
+`b2b_counter_value`, `b2b_certificate_orbit`, and `b2b_verifies_iff` identify the
+enumerated predicate, including width zero. The loop trajectory clauses reduce
+all body-head positions to a single round's positions; the row trajectories keep
+them within the seven fixed windows of route H. Their common enclosing radius is
+the sum below. `Finset.card_le_card` and `Int.card_Icc`, summed over the fixed
+number of tapes, give the ledger. Only the final `b2b_answer_run` emits physically.
+
+Status: proved. Setup is `b2b_setup_run`; the search, with its counted loop over
+`b2b_round_run` and its global trajectory bound, is `b2b_search_contract`. -/
+private theorem b2b_host_contract (C c e cV cI cP : ℕ) (V : Language Bool)
+    (MV MI MP : FinTM Bool)
+    (hV : ∀ y : List Bool,
+      LogProg.CleanRun (LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀)
+        (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y
+        (MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) y) (cV * (y.length ^ e + 1)))
+    (hI : MI.ComputesFunInTime id (fun n => cI * (n + 1)))
+    (hIs : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), MI.tm.spaceUsed (MI.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ cI)
+    (hP : MP.ComputesFunInTime
+      (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ c) true)
+      (fun n => cP * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1)))
+    (hPs : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), MP.tm.spaceUsed (MP.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ cP * (x.length + 1))
+    (x : List Bool) :
+    ∃ t : ℕ,
+      (b2b_host MV MI MP).ComputesInTime x
+        [MultiTapeTM.indicator
+          {z : List Bool | ∃ u, u.length = C * (z.length + 1) ^ c ∧ z ++ u ∈ V} x] t ∧
+      (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm.spaceUsed ((b2b_host MV MI MP).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
+        (b2b_tapeCount MV.k MI.k MP.k + 1) *
+          (2 * (x.length + C * (x.length + 1) ^ c +
+            cV * ((x.length + C * (x.length + 1) ^ c) ^ e + 1) +
+            cI + cP * (x.length + 1) + 1) + 1) := by
+  classical
+  let Q := C * (x.length + 1) ^ c
+  let W := x.length + Q + cV * ((x.length + Q) ^ e + 1) + cI + cP * (x.length + 1) + 1
+  let H := (b2b_host MV MI MP).tm
+  obtain ⟨T, hsetup, hsetupHeads⟩ := b2b_setup_run MV MI MP x Q
+    (cP * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) (cP * (x.length + 1)) (hP x) (hPs x _)
+  obtain ⟨t, hhalt, hout, hsearchHeads⟩ := b2b_search_contract Q e cV cI V MV MI MP hV hI hIs x
+  have hheads (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ T + t) (j : Fin (b2b_host MV MI MP).k) :
+      |(H.runFrom (H.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j| ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
+    by_cases hpre : u ≤ T
+    · exact (hsetupHeads u hpre j).trans (by
+        exact_mod_cast (show cP * (x.length + 1) + Q + 1 ≤ W by dsimp [W]; omega))
+    · have heq : u = T + (u - T) := by omega
+      rw [heq, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hsetup]
+      exact (hsearchHeads (u - T) (by omega) j).trans (by
+        exact_mod_cast (show x.length + Q + cV * ((x.length + Q) ^ e + 1) + cI + 1 ≤ W by
+          dsimp [W]; omega))
+  refine ⟨T + t, (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
+  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hsetup]
+    exact hhalt
+  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hsetup]
+    simpa only [MultiTapeTM.indicator, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Q] using hout
+  · change H.spaceUsed (H.initCfg x) (T + t) ≤ (b2b_host MV MI MP).k * (2 * W + 1)
+    calc
+      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (b2b_host MV MI MP).k, (Finset.Icc (-(W : ℤ)) (W : ℤ)).card := by
+        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+        intro j _
+        apply Finset.card_le_card
+        intro z hz
+        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
+        have hu' : u ≤ T + t := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hu; omega
+        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp (hheads u hu' j))
+      _ = (b2b_host MV MI MP).k * (2 * W + 1) := by
+        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Int.card_Icc]
+        congr 1
+        omega
+

## ===== audits/evidence/b2b/B2bFill1AdmissionWalk.lean.txt =====

import Lean.Util.FoldConsts
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Inclusions
open Lean Elab Command in
/-- Every constant in the dependency closure of `root` whose own type or value
mentions `sorryAx` (maintainer's read-only admission walk). -/
def sorrySourcesOf (env : Environment) (root : Name) : Array Name := Id.run do
  let mut visited : NameSet := {}
  let mut stack : Array Name := #[root]
  let mut srcs : Array Name := #[]
  while !stack.isEmpty do
    let c := stack.back!
    stack := stack.pop
    if visited.contains c then continue
    visited := visited.insert c
    if let some ci := env.find? c then
      let used := ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet
      if used.contains ``sorryAx then srcs := srcs.push c
      for d in used.toList do
        unless visited.contains d do stack := stack.push d
  return srcs

open Lean Elab Command in
elab "#sorry_sources " id:ident : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverload id
  logInfo m!"{n}: direct sorryAx users in closure: {sorrySourcesOf (← getEnv) n}"
#sorry_sources Complexity.NP_subset_PSPACE
#sorry_sources Complexity.SAT3_mem_PSPACE

open Lean Elab Command in
/-- Every constant whose name starts with the given string (a module's private prefix), and
those among them whose own type or value mentions `sorryAx` (maintainer's read-only census). -/
elab "#private_sorry_census " pre:str : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let p := pre.getString
  let mut n := 0
  let mut bad : Array Name := #[]
  for (c, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    if (toString c).startsWith p then
      n := n + 1
      if ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.contains ``sorryAx then bad := bad.push c
  logInfo m!"{p}: {n} constants; direct sorryAx users: {bad}"

/-! ## Part B — route steps -/

namespace F4Probe

/-- Route 2: the SAT3 corollary, verbatim (modulo route 1). -/
example : SAT3 ∈ PSPACE := NP_subset_PSPACE SAT3_mem_NP

/-- G-0 (no new machinery): the verifier language `V ∈ P` has a decider whose
cleaned machine, on every word `y`, halts with the indicator, blank work tapes and
origin heads, every head within a radius polynomial in `|y|`. Space comes from
`P_subset_PSPACE` (that is, `DTIME_subset_SPACE` at the verifier's time bound),
and the clean-up is `Complexity.LogProg.cleanTM_run`. -/
theorem clean_verifier (V : Language Bool) (hV : V ∈ P) :
    ∃ (e cV : ℕ) (MV : FinTM Bool), ∀ y : List Bool, ∃ T : ℕ,
      ((LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀).runFrom
          (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y) T).state = none ∧
      ((LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀).runFrom
          (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y) T).output =
        [MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) y] ∧
      ((LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀).runFrom
          (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y) T).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none) ∧
      ((LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀).runFrom
          (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y) T).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ j, |((LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀).runFrom
          (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀) y) t).workTapePos j| ≤
            (cV * (y.length ^ e + 1) : ℕ) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (P_subset_PSPACE hV)
  obtain ⟨cV, MV, hMV⟩ := he
  refine ⟨e, cV, MV, fun y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hsp⟩ := hMV y
  obtain ⟨hh, ho⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp ht
  have hs : ∀ i, (MV.tm.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.init MV.tm.q₀ y) t i).card ≤
      cV * (y.length ^ e + 1) := fun i =>
    (MV.tm.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed _ t i).trans hsp
  obtain ⟨T, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ :=
    LogProg.cleanTM_run MV.tm MV.tm.q₀ MV.tm.q₀ y t hh _ hs
  exact ⟨T, h1, h2.trans ho, h3, h4, h5⟩

/-- G-2: the input rewind glue. Its table is the `timed_rewind` shape, so its
contract is an instance of the public lemma with no new induction. Under
`vhostEmitTM` it rewinds the buffer head. -/
inductive RwPh | start | scan | done
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- `halt = false`: end in the live anchor `done` (a seam exit);
`halt = true`: halt, so an enclosing R1′ return can fire. -/
def rewindDest (halt : Bool) : Option RwPh := if halt then none else some .done

def rewindTM (k : ℕ) (halt : Bool) : MultiTapeTM k Bool RwPh where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q with
    | .start => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
    | .scan =>
      match inp with
      | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)
      | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (rewindDest halt)
    | .done => FinTM.controlAction 0 (some .done)

theorem rewindTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (halt : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool RwPh x)
    (hs : c.state = some .start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (rewindTM k halt).runFrom c r = { c with state := rewindDest halt, inputPos := 1 } :=
  FinTM.timed_rewind (rewindTM k halt) .start .scan (rewindDest halt) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl) c hs

/-- The same contract with the work-head trajectory, from the newly public
`FinTM.rewind_heads` (pre-issue 2). -/
theorem rewindTM_run_heads {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (halt : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool RwPh x)
    (hs : c.state = some .start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (rewindTM k halt).runFrom c r = { c with state := rewindDest halt, inputPos := 1 } ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, ((rewindTM k halt).runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos :=
  FinTM.rewind_heads (rewindTM k halt) .start .scan (rewindDest halt) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl) c hs

/-- **Work-tape origin finding by virtual input** (revision 2, the setup's key step).
Host the halting rewind on a buffer tape holding a word `w` with its head anywhere in
`[-1, |w|]` (the capture leaves it at `|w|`): the buffer head returns to `0` and the buffer
is unchanged. Only public rows: `vhostEmitTM_runFrom` and the rewind instance. -/
theorem vhost_rewind {x y : List Bool} (c : Cfg 0 Bool RwPh y) (hs : c.state = some .start)
    (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) :
    ∃ u ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, ∃ b',
      (vhostEmitTM (rewindTM 0 true)).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) u =
        vhostCfg ({ c with state := none, inputPos := 1 } : Cfg 0 Bool RwPh y) b' p pre ∧
      ((vhostEmitTM (rewindTM 0 true)).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) u).workTapePos
        (vhostBuffer 0) = 0 ∧
      ((vhostEmitTM (rewindTM 0 true)).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) u).workTapes
        (vhostBuffer 0) = FinTM.bufferTape y := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hrun⟩ := rewindTM_run true c hs
  obtain ⟨b', _, he⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom (rewindTM 0 true) c b hb p pre u
  rw [hrun] at he
  refine ⟨u, hu, b', he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]; simp only [vhostCfg, vhostBuffer, Fin.addCases_left]; simp
  · rw [he]; simp only [vhostCfg, vhostBuffer, Fin.addCases_left]

/-- G-3: the verdict reader on a capture tape `i` holding `[b]` with its head on
cell `1` (the R1′ capture convention): one left step, then read, erase, and enter
the live anchor `done b`. Two steps; the tape ends blank with its head at `0`. -/
inductive VrPh | left | read | done (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

def verdictTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool VrPh where
  q₀ := .left
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .left => tapeAction i 0 none .neg .read
    | .read =>
      match w i with
      | some b => tapeAction i 0 (some none) 0 (.done b)
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none 0 (.done false)
    | .done b => inputMoveAction 0 (.done b)

theorem verdictTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool VrPh x) (b : Bool)
    (hs : d.state = some .left) (hb : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - 1) = some b) :
    ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).state = some (.done b) ∧
      ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).workTapePos i = d.workTapePos i - 1 ∧
      ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - 1) = none ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧
        ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).inputPos = d.inputPos ∧
      ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2).output = d.output := by
  have h1 : (verdictTM k i).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with state := some .read,
               workTapePos := fun j => if j = i then d.workTapePos j - 1 else d.workTapePos j } := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;>
      simp [MultiTapeTM.runFrom, MultiTapeTM.step, hs, verdictTM, tapeAction, Action.apply,
        moveInputPos_zero]
    · funext j; by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
    · funext j; by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hr : (verdictTM k i).runFrom d 2 = (verdictTM k i).step ((verdictTM k i).runFrom d 1) :=
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'
  rw [hr, h1]
  simp [MultiTapeTM.step, verdictTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hb, tapeAction, Action.apply,
    moveInputPos_zero]
  refine ⟨by rw [if_pos rfl]; exact Function.update_self _ _ _, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  simp [hj]

/-- The counter word `1^Q` has value `2^Q - 1`: `d = 2^Q - 1` rounds, and the
done-continuation tests the last certificate. -/
theorem ofDigits_replicate_true (Q : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((List.replicate Q true).map Bool.toNat) = 2 ^ Q - 1 := by
  induction Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ Q ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih]
    have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ Q := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    simp only [Bool.toNat_true, pow_succ]
    omega

/-- The certificate orbit: from `0^Q`, the `r`-th certificate is `enumWord Q r`
for every `r < 2^Q`, through the public increment arithmetic. -/
theorem orbit_enumWord (Q r : ℕ) (hr : r < 2 ^ Q) :
    (fun u => (incFixed u).getD u)^[r] (List.replicate Q false) = enumWord Q r := by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact (Meyer.enumWord_zero Q).symm
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih (by omega),
      Meyer.incFixed_enumWord Q r hr, Option.getD_some]

/-- Completeness: every width-`Q` certificate is some `enumWord Q r`, `r < 2^Q`. -/
theorem enumWord_onto (u : List Bool) :
    ∃ r < 2 ^ u.length, enumWord u.length r = u :=
  ⟨TimeHierarchy.ctrVal u, Meyer.ctrVal_lt u, Meyer.enumWord_ctrVal u⟩

/-- Final packaging (P4.1 Q5 normalization): a decider with a halting time and a
ledger `D·(n+1)^f` puts the language in `PSPACE`. -/
theorem mem_PSPACE_of_ledger (L : Language Bool) (M : FinTM Bool) (D f : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t,
      M.ComputesInTime x [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x] t ∧
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ D * (x.length + 1) ^ f) :
    L ∈ PSPACE := by
  have hS : L ∈ SPACE (fun n => D * (n + 1) ^ f) := ⟨1, M, fun x => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := h x
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simpa using hs⟩⟩
  refine space_poly_subset_PSPACE f (SPACE.mono_const (a := D * 2 ^ f) (fun n => ?_) hS)
  calc D * (n + 1) ^ f ≤ D * (2 ^ f * (n ^ f + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left D (succ_pow_le n f)
    _ = D * 2 ^ f * (n ^ f + 1) := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

/-- The host's state types are finite and decidable, so the host packs into a
`FinTM`: the cleaned decider, its R1′ return, the virtual-input host, the
counter loop, the seams. -/
example (MV : FinTM Bool) :
    Fintype ((LogProg.CleanSt MV.State MV.k ⊕ Unit) × Bool) := inferInstance
example (MV : FinTM Bool) :
    DecidableEq ((LogProg.CleanSt MV.State MV.k ⊕ Unit) × Bool) := inferInstance
example (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] :
    Fintype (((CounterLoopState S ⊕ FlagPhase) ⊕ SweepPhase)) := inferInstance
example : Fintype (RwPh ⊕ VrPh) := inferInstance

/-- Type-level assembly of the hosted source `D` (rewind; cleaned decider with a
live exit; rewind) and its R1′ call on `1 + 2k` bank tapes, so the tape counts of
the seams and the virtual-input host match. -/
noncomputable def hostedSource (MV : FinTM Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (MV.k + MV.k) Bool
      ((RwPh ⊕ Unit) ⊕ ((LogProg.CleanSt MV.State MV.k ⊕ Unit) ⊕ RwPh)) :=
  seamCompTM (embedEmitRetTM (Function.Embedding.refl _) (rewindTM _ true)) (Sum.inr ())
    (seamCompTM (embedEmitRetTM (Function.Embedding.refl _)
        (LogProg.cleanTM MV.tm MV.tm.q₀)) (Sum.inr ())
      (rewindTM _ true) .start)
    (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (LogProg.CleanSt.init MV.tm.q₀)))

/-- The anchor phase: one stationary state, always redirected by the phase host, so the
loop anchor is a state the round never revisits. -/
def anchorTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM k Bool Unit where
  q₀ := ()
  tr := fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()

/-- Revision 2 assembly check: a phase-host body (any finite phase family) is a valid
`counterLoopTM` body, and the hosts' state types are finite and decidable, so the whole
host packs into a `FinTM` with no seam composite and no R8.8. -/
noncomputable def loopOverPhases {k : ℕ} {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] {Ph : I → Type}
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (Ph i)] (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Bool (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (a e : Σ i, Ph i) :
    MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ i, Ph i)) :=
  counterLoopTM (phaseHostTM M q0 red) a (some e)

example {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {Ph : I → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (Ph i)]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (Ph i)] : Fintype (CounterLoopState (Σ i, Ph i)) := inferInstance
example {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] {Ph : I → Type} [∀ i, DecidableEq (Ph i)] :
    DecidableEq (CounterLoopState (Σ i, Ph i)) := inferInstance

/-- The phase host's dispatch lands on the next phase's start in the form its own lemma
consumes: retagging commutes with control replacement. -/
theorem dispatch_retag {k : ℕ} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (j : I) (q : Ph j) :
    c.mapState (fun _ => (⟨j, q⟩ : Σ i, Ph i)) =
      (c.mapState (fun _ => q)).mapState (Sigma.mk j) := by
  cases c; simp [Cfg.mapState]; cases ‹Option S› <;> rfl

/-- The halting rewind's first halt, as `exists_first_halt` gives it, feeds the
R1′ return (`embedEmitRetTM_run`) for a live, first-visited exit. -/
theorem rewind_first_halt {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool RwPh x)
    (hs : c.state = some .start) :
    ∃ u ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2, (∀ v < u, ¬((rewindTM k true).runFrom c v).Halted) ∧
      (rewindTM k true).runFrom c u = { c with state := none, inputPos := 1 } := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrun⟩ := rewindTM_run true c hs
  have hh : ((rewindTM k true).runFrom c r).state = none := by rw [hrun]; rfl
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlive, heq⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt _ c hh
  exact ⟨u, hu.trans hr, hlive, heq.trans hrun⟩

noncomputable def hostedCall (MV : FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (ι : Fin (1 + (MV.k + MV.k)) ↪ Fin K)
    (cap : Fin K) :=
  embedSilentRetTM ι cap (vhostEmitTM (hostedSource MV))

#check @hostedCall

end F4Probe

#print axioms F4Probe.clean_verifier
#print axioms F4Probe.rewindTM_run
#print axioms F4Probe.rewindTM_run_heads
#print axioms F4Probe.vhost_rewind
#print axioms F4Probe.dispatch_retag
#print axioms F4Probe.ofDigits_replicate_true
#print axioms F4Probe.orbit_enumWord
#print axioms F4Probe.enumWord_onto
#print axioms F4Probe.mem_PSPACE_of_ledger
#print axioms F4Probe.verdictTM_run
#print axioms F4Probe.rewind_first_halt

@counterLoopTM_run_done : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst : DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (a : S)
  (exit : Option S) (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
  (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
    ∀ (d : ℕ),
      Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = d →
        (∀ r < d,
            (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r).state = some a ∧
              0 < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∧
                (∀ (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      u < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) →
                        ∃ s,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ a ∧ exit ≠ some s) ∧
                  (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r + 1)).state = some a) →
          ∀ (T : ℕ),
            T = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range d, τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) + counterOverhead w (d + 1) →
              MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) T =
                  counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.done) (counterLoopOrbit M τ c d)
                    (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then some true else ct q) cp ∧
                (∀ t < T,
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) t).state ≠
                        some CounterLoopState.done ∧
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                            t).state ≠
                        some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧
                  (∀ t ≤ T,
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                              t).workTapePos
                          (Fin.last k) ∈
                        Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                    ∀ t ≤ T,
                      ∃ r u,
                        (r < d ∧ u ≤ τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∨ r = d ∧ u = 0) ∧
                          ∀ (j : Fin k),
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                    t).workTapePos
                                j.castSucc =
                              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).workTapePos j
@counterLoopTM_run_escape : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst : DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
  (a e : S),
  e ≠ a →
    ∀ (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
      (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
        ∀ r₀ < Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w),
          (∀ r ≤ r₀,
              (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r).state = some a ∧
                0 < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∧
                  ∀ (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      u < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) →
                        ∃ s, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ a ∧ s ≠ e) →
            (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r₀ + 1)).state = some e →
              ∀ (T : ℕ),
                T = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (r₀ + 1), τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) + counterOverhead w (r₀ + 1) →
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp) T =
                      counterLoopCfg (some CounterLoopState.escape) (counterLoopOrbit M τ c (r₀ + 1))
                        (fun q =>
                          if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + ↑w.length then FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w (r₀ + 1)) (q - cp)
                          else ct q)
                        cp ∧
                    (∀ t < T,
                        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                t).state ≠
                            some CounterLoopState.done ∧
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                t).state ≠
                            some CounterLoopState.escape) ∧
                      (∀ t ≤ T,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                  t).workTapePos
                              (Fin.last k) ∈
                            Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + ↑w.length)) ∧
                        ∀ t ≤ T,
                          ∃ r u,
                            (r ≤ r₀ ∧ u ≤ τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∨ r = r₀ + 1 ∧ u = 0) ∧
                              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom
                                        (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) c ct cp)
                                        t).workTapePos
                                    j.castSucc =
                                  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).workTapePos j

          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * (List.takeWhile id w).length + 2) =

    ∀ (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (vhostCfg c b p pre) t (vhostBuffer m) =
        Finset.image (fun u => ↑↑(MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).inputPos - 1) (Finset.range (t + 1))
@vhostCfg_buffer_head_mem : ∀ {m : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {x y : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
  (b : Bool),
  FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b →
    ∀ (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) t).workTapePos (vhostBuffer m) ∈ Finset.Icc (-1) ↑y.length
@vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le : ∀ {m : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {x y : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
  (b : Bool),
  FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b →
    ∀ (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed (vhostCfg c b p pre) t ≤ MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed c t + (y.length + 2)
@FinTM.VirtualTag : {n : ℕ} → Fin (n + 2) → Bool → Prop
@FinTM.bufferTape : {Symbol : Type u_1} → List Symbol → ℤ → Option Symbol
@embedEmitTM : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S
@embedEmitCfg : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {x : List Symbol} →
        (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → (Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) → (Fin k → ℤ) → List Symbol → Cfg m Symbol S x → Cfg k Symbol S x
@embedEmitTM_runFrom : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t = embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin m),
  MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t (ι i) = MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c t i ∧
    MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t (ι i) = MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape c t i
@embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
  (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
  ∀ j ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t j = {heads j} ∧
      MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t j = 1
@embedSilentCfg : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {x : List Symbol} →
        (Fin m ↪ Fin k) →
          Fin k →
            (Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) → (Fin k → ℤ) → List Symbol → List Symbol → Cfg m Symbol S x → Cfg k Symbol S x
@embedSilentRetTM : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S ⊕ Unit)
@embedSilentRetTM_run : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k),
  ∀ cap ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    ∀ (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre out₀ : List Symbol)
      (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (T : ℕ),
      c.state ≠ none →
        (∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) →
          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T).state = none →
            (∀ t < T,
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) t =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t))) ∧
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) T =
                  have __src := embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T);
                  { state := some (Sum.inr ()), inputPos := __src.inputPos, workTapes := __src.workTapes,
                    workTapePos := __src.workTapePos, output := __src.output }) ∧
                ∀ t < T,
                  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) t).state ≠
                    some (Sum.inr ())
@embedSilentRetTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
  (pre out₀ : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin k),
  MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) t j =
    MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c) t j
@embedEmitRetTM : {m k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S ⊕ Unit)
@embedEmitRetTM_run : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (T : ℕ),
  c.state ≠ none →
    (∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) →
      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T).state = none →
        (∀ t < T,
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c)) t =
              Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t))) ∧
          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c)) T =
              have __src := embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T);
              { state := some (Sum.inr ()), inputPos := __src.inputPos, workTapes := __src.workTapes,
                workTapePos := __src.workTapePos, output := __src.output }) ∧
            ∀ t < T,
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c)) t).state ≠
                some (Sum.inr ())
@embedEmitRetTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin k),
  MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c)) t j =
    MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c) t j
@MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Symbol}
  (src : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Symbol H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop),
  (∀ (q : S),
      good q →
        ∀ (inp : Option Symbol) (work : Fin k → Option Symbol),
          host.tr (emb q) inp work = Action.mapState (⇑emb) (src.tr q inp work)) →
    ∀ (c : Cfg k Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),
      (∀ u < t, ∀ (q : S), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some q → good q) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) t = Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@seamCompTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {S₁ : Type u_1} →
    {S₂ : Type u_2} →
      {Symbol : Type u_3} →
        [DecidableEq S₁] → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁ → S₁ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂ → S₂ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S₁ ⊕ S₂)
@seamCompTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ = c₃ →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) = Cfg.mapState Sum.inr c₃
@seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry q₂ : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {c₃ : Cfg k Symbol S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ = c₃ →
          c₃.state = some q₂ →
            (∀ t < T₂, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) t).state ≠ some q₂) →
              ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr q₂)
@seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ},
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁ →
    c₁.state = some exit →
      (∀ t < T₁, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit) →
        ∀ (i : Fin k),
          MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) i ⊆
            MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c₀ T₁ i ∪
              MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry) c₁) T₂ i
@seamCompTM_runFrom_left : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₁] (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (exit : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry : S₂)
  {c : Cfg k Symbol S₁ x} {T : ℕ},
  (∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ some exit) →
    ∀ t ≤ T, MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c) t = Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t)
@seamCompTM₂ : {k : ℕ} →
  {S₁ : Type u_1} →
    {S₂ : Type u_2} →
      {Symbol : Type u_3} →
        {S₀ : Type u_4} →
          [DecidableEq S₀] →
            [DecidableEq S₁] →
              MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀ →
                S₀ →
                  S₀ →
                    MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁ → S₁ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂ → S₂ → MultiTapeTM k Symbol ((S₀ ⊕ S₁) ⊕ S₂)
@seamCompTM₂_run_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S₁ : Type u_1} {S₂ : Type u_2} {Symbol : Type u_3} {S₀ : Type u_4} {x : List Symbol}
  [inst : DecidableEq S₀] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S₁] (M₀ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₀) (e₁ e₂ : S₀),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    ∀ (M₁ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₁) (entry₁ : S₁) (M₂ : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S₂) (entry₂ : S₂)
      {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Symbol S₀ x} {T₀ : ℕ},
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ T₀ = c₁ →
        (∀ t < T₀, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₁ ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some e₂) →
          (c₁.state = some e₁ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inl
                    (Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₁) c₁) t))) ∧
            (c₁.state = some e₂ →
              ∀ (t : ℕ),
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl c₀)) (T₀ + 1 + t) =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inr (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => entry₂) c₁) t))
@phaseHostTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ I : Type} →
    {Ph : I → Type} →
      ((i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) →
        (i : I) × Ph i → ((i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) → MultiTapeTM k Γ ((i : I) × Ph i)
@phaseHostTM_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i)
  (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T = c' →
    ∀ (s' : Ph i),
      c'.state = some s' →
        ∀ (q' : (i : I) × Ph i),
          red i s' = some q' →
            (∀ u < T, ∀ (s : Ph i), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) →
              (∀ u ≤ T,
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) u =
                    Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u)) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) (T + 1) = Cfg.mapState (fun x => q') c'
@counter_cfg_eq : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (q : Option (CounterLoopState S)) (c : Cfg k Bool S x)
  (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
  counterLoopCfg q c ct cp =
    { state := q, inputPos := c.inputPos,
      workTapes := fun i => Fin.lastCases (motive := fun x => ℤ → Option Bool) ct c.workTapes i,
      workTapePos := fun i => Fin.lastCases cp c.workTapePos i, output := c.output }
@FinTM.rewind_heads : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S)
  (dest : Option S),
  (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
      tm.tr start inp work = FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)) →
    (∀ (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool),
        tm.tr scan inp work =
          match inp with
          | some val => FinTM.controlAction SignType.neg (some scan)
          | none => FinTM.controlAction SignType.pos dest) →
      ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool S x),
        c.state = some start →
          ∃ r ≤ ↑c.inputPos + 2,
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom c r =
                { state := dest, inputPos := 1, workTapes := c.workTapes, workTapePos := c.workTapePos,
                  output := c.output } ∧
              ∀ u ≤ r, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos
@seamReleaseTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {S : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → MultiTapeTM k Symbol S → S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (Unit ⊕ S)
@seamReleaseTM_firstReturn : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S)
  (anchor : S) {c c' : Cfg k Symbol S x} {T : ℕ},
  c.state = some anchor →
    0 < T →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T = c' →
        c'.state = some anchor →
          (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → t < T → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ some anchor) →
            MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) T = Cfg.mapState Sum.inr c' ∧
              ∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr anchor)
@seamReleaseTM_visitedByTapeHead : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (anchor : S) {c : Cfg k Symbol S x},
  c.state = some anchor →
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k),
      MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.mapState (fun x => Sum.inl ()) c) t i = MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead c t i
@LogProg.cleanTM : {k : ℕ} → {S : Type} → MultiTapeTM k Bool S → S → MultiTapeTM (k + k) Bool (LogProg.CleanSt S k)
LogProg.CleanSt : Type → ℕ → Type
@LogProg.cleanTM_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (q₁ q : S) (V : List Bool) (T : ℕ),
  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init q V) T).state = none →
    ∀ (s : ℕ),
      (∀ (i : Fin k), (MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.init q V) T i).card ≤ s) →
        ∃ T',
          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init q) V) T').state = none ∧
            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init q) V) T').output =
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init q V) T).output ∧
              ((MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init q) V) T').workTapes = fun x x_1 => none) ∧
                ((MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init q) V) T').workTapePos = fun x => 0) ∧
                  ∀ t ≤ T',
                    ∀ (j : Fin (k + k)),
                      |(MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.init (LogProg.CleanSt.init q) V) t).workTapePos j| ≤ ↑s
FinTM.exists_inputCallTM : ∀ (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
  M.ComputesFunInTime f T →
    ∃ C entry exit c,
      0 < C.k ∧
        ∀ (x : List Bool),
          ∃ t ≤ c * (T x.length + x.length + (f x).length + 1),
            0 < t ∧
              (∀ (t' : ℕ),
                  0 < t' → t' < t → (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry fun x => []) t').state ≠ some exit) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry fun x => []) t = Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f x))
FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary : ∀ (C e : ℕ),
  ∃ M c, M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)
FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed : ∀ (C e : ℕ),
  ∃ M c,
    (M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed (MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1)
stateWord : (k : ℕ) → List Bool → Fin k → List Bool
FinTM.computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed : ∃ M c,
  (M.ComputesFunInTime id fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧
    ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed (MultiTapeTM.initCfg x) t ≤ c
@embedEmitCfg_selected_tape : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (i : Fin m),
  (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c).workTapes (ι i) = c.workTapes i
@embedEmitCfg_selected_pos : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
  (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (i : Fin m),
  (embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads pre c).workTapePos (ι i) = c.workTapePos i
@Cfg.init : {k : ℕ} →
  {State : Type u_1} → {Symbol : Type u_2} → State → (input : List Symbol) → Cfg k Symbol State input
MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.abs_lt_card_image_of_unitSteps : ∀ (p : ℕ → ℤ),
  p 0 = 0 →
    (∀ (j : ℕ), |p (j + 1) - p j| ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (t : ℕ) {z : ℤ}, z ∈ Finset.image p (Finset.range (t + 1)) → |z| < ↑(Finset.image p (Finset.range (t + 1))).card
@counterLoopTM_run_done : ∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [inst : DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (a : S)
  (exit : Option S) (τ : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ),
  (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
    ∀ (d : ℕ),
      Nat.ofDigits 2 (List.map Bool.toNat w) = d →
        (∀ r < d,
            (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r).state = some a ∧
              0 < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) ∧
                (∀ (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      u < τ (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) →
                        ∃ s,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (counterLoopOrbit M τ c r) u).state = some s ∧ s ≠ a ∧ exit ≠ some s) ∧

              { state := some (FlagPhase.done true), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * (List.takeWhile id w).length + 2,
                ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * (List.takeWhile id w).length + 2,
                  if j = i then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑(List.takeWhile id w).length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool),
  incFixed w = none →
    ∀ (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x),
      d.state = some FlagPhase.run →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some (FlagPhase.done false), inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length false) (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ (b : Bool), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = i then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape : ∀ {x : List Bool} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (t : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords FlagPhase.run w) t i ≤ (w i).length + 2 ∧
    ∀ (j : Fin k), j ≠ i → MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1
@copyTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k),
  src ≠ dst →
    ∀ (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
      d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
        (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
              { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                    FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)
                  else d.workTapes j q,
                workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
            (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
              ∀ (j : Fin k),
                ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
                  if j = src ∨ j = dst then
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
                      Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
                  else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then none else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

@vhostEmitTM_runFrom : ∀ {m : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {x y : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
  (b : Bool),
  FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b →

      ∃ b',

@vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_bank : ∀ {m : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {x y : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
  (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool),

@vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer : ∀ {m : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {x y : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
  (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool),

      MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead (vhostCfg c b p pre) t (vhostBuffer m) =
        Finset.image (fun u => ↑↑(MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).inputPos - 1) (Finset.range (t + 1))

  (b : Bool),

  (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre : List Symbol)
  (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin m),

@embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol}
  (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
  (pre : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ),

  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} →
      {x : List Symbol} →

          Fin k →

  {S : Type u_1} →
    {Symbol : Type u_2} → (Fin m ↪ Fin k) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM m Symbol S → MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S ⊕ Unit)
@embedSilentRetTM_run : ∀ {m k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {x : List Symbol} (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k),
  ∀ cap ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    ∀ (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (pre out₀ : List Symbol)
      (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (T : ℕ),
      c.state ≠ none →
        (∀ t < T, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) →
          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T).state = none →
            (∀ t < T,
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) t =
                  Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c t))) ∧
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) T =
                  have __src := embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T);
                  { state := some (Sum.inr ()), inputPos := __src.inputPos, workTapes := __src.workTapes,
                    workTapePos := __src.workTapePos, output := __src.output }) ∧
                ∀ t < T,
                  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState Sum.inl (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ c)) t).state ≠
                    some (Sum.inr ())

  (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Symbol S) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Symbol) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
  (pre out₀ : List Symbol) (c : Cfg m Symbol S x) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin k),
