    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (skipBackTM k i) D 0 rfl rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
  have result := catalog_pass_contract (skipBackTM k i) F D (u.length + 2) hF hexit hD
    (fun c => c.state ≠ some .done)
    (fun c => ∀ j : Fin k, if j = i then
      c.workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
      else c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)
    (by intro r _; simp only [F, catalogSeekCfg]; split_ifs <;> simp)
    (by
      intro r hr j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      · simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, hj])
    (by
      intro j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [D, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      · simp [D, hj])
  rw [h0] at result
  exact ⟨result.1, result.2.1, fun j t ht => result.2.2 t ht j⟩

/-- Nonempty fields admit no adjacent blanks strictly before the terminal pair.
Proof sketch: an interior first-field cell is nonblank; its separator is followed by
the next field's first cell; beyond it, shift to the tail and use induction. -/
private theorem fieldsTape_no_double_blank {Γ : Type*} (ws : List (List Γ))
    (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) (z : ℤ) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hend : z + 1 < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ)) :
    ¬(fieldsTape ws z = none ∧ fieldsTape ws (z + 1) = none) := by
  induction ws generalizing z with
  | nil => simp [fieldOffset] at hend; omega
  | cons u ws ih =>
    have hu : u ≠ [] := hws u (by simp)
    have hul : 0 < u.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hu
    have htail : ∀ v ∈ ws, v ≠ [] := fun v hv => hws v (by simp [hv])
    by_cases hin : z < u.length
    · intro hblank
      have h := fieldsTape_field (u :: ws) 0 (by simp) z (by omega) (by simpa using hin.le)
      simp only [fieldOffset, List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
        zero_add, List.getElem_cons_zero] at h
      rw [h, FinTM.bufferTape, if_pos hz,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega : z.toNat < u.length)] at hblank
      exact Option.noConfusion hblank.1
    · cases ws with
      | nil => simp [fieldOffset] at hend; omega
      | cons v ws =>
        have hoff := fieldOffset_cons_succ u (v :: ws) (v :: ws).length
        have hlen : (u :: v :: ws).length = (v :: ws).length + 1 := rfl
        rw [hlen, hoff] at hend
        by_cases he : z = (u.length : ℤ)
        · intro hblank
          have h := fieldsTape_field (v :: ws) 0 (by simp) 0 (by omega) (by simp)
          have hv : 0 < v.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (htail v (by simp))
          simp only [fieldOffset, List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
            zero_add, List.getElem_cons_zero] at h
          rw [he, show (u.length : ℤ) + 1 = (u.length : ℤ) + 1 + 0 by omega,
            fieldsTape_cons_shift u v ws 0 (by omega), h] at hblank
          simpa [FinTM.bufferTape, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hv] using hblank.2
        · have hshift : 0 ≤ z - ((u.length : ℤ) + 1) := by omega
          have h := ih htail (z - ((u.length : ℤ) + 1)) hshift (by omega)
          intro hblank
          apply h
          constructor
          · rw [← fieldsTape_cons_shift u v ws _ (by omega)]
            convert hblank.1 using 1
            congr 1
            omega
          · rw [← fieldsTape_cons_shift u v ws _ (by omega)]
            convert hblank.2 using 1
            congr 1
            omega

/-- **R8.3, seek to the end of a table** (design §12.8a, decision O5). Move the
head of tape `i` right across blank-separated fields until two consecutive
blank cells, and stop on the second, where a further field would start.
`run` crosses field cells, `gap` follows a single blank, and a second blank
enters `done` without moving. Nothing is written. -/
def seekEndTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase where
  q₀ := .run
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .run =>
      match w i with
      | some _ => tapeAction i 0 none .pos .run
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .pos .gap
    | .gap =>
      match w i with
      | some _ => tapeAction i 0 none .pos .run
      | none => inputMoveAction 0 .done
    | q => inputMoveAction 0 q

/-- **R8.3, seek to the end, framed** (design §12.8a). Let tape `i` hold, from
its head, a nonempty list `ws` of nonempty fields in the field layout, followed
by two blank cells. Write `D = fieldOffset ws |ws|` for the span of the layout
plus one. Then the seek reaches `done` at exactly `D + 1` and not earlier, with
the head of tape `i` at `pos + D` and nothing else changed. The cells beyond
`pos + D` are arbitrary. Up to the exit the head stays within
`[pos, pos + D]`, and every other head is fixed. The fields must be nonempty,
since an empty field is a double blank; `ws ≠ []` excludes the empty table,
whose end is its start.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `ws`. A field `u` is `|u|` right steps in `run`;
its terminating blank is one right step into `gap`; the next cell is the first
cell of the next field, one right step back into `run`, or the second blank,
one stationary step into `done`. The per-field cost `|u| + 1` sums to `D`. -/
theorem seekEndTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hne : ws ≠ []) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ [])
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = fieldsTape ws p) :
    (seekEndTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧
      (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1,
        ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + fieldOffset ws ws.length)
        else ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  classical
  let L := fieldOffset ws ws.length
  let F := fun r : ℕ => catalogSeekCfg i d
    (if r = 0 then .run else if fieldsTape ws ((r : ℤ) - 1) = none then .gap else .run) r
  let D : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x := { d with
    state := some .done
    workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + L) }
  have hlength : (joinFields ws).length + 1 = L := length_joinFields_add_one ws hne
  have hpos : 0 < L := by omega
  have endblank (p : ℤ) (hp : (L : ℤ) - 1 ≤ p) : fieldsTape ws p = none := by
    unfold fieldsTape
    split_ifs with h0
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
      rfl
    · rfl
  have read (q : SeekPhase) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ L) :
      (catalogSeekCfg i d q r).workTapeSymbols i = fieldsTape ws r := by
    simpa [catalogSeekCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols] using hw r (by omega) (by omega)
  have h0 : F 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, hstate]
  have hF (r : ℕ) (hr : r < L) : (seekEndTM k i).step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    let q : SeekPhase := if r = 0 then .run else
      if fieldsTape ws ((r : ℤ) - 1) = none then .gap else .run
    have htr : (seekEndTM k i).tr q (catalogSeekCfg i d q r).inputSymbol
        (catalogSeekCfg i d q r).workTapeSymbols =
        tapeAction i 0 none .pos (if fieldsTape ws r = none then .gap else .run) := by
      cases hc : fieldsTape ws (r : ℤ) with
      | none =>
        have hq : q = .run := by
          by_cases hr0 : r = 0
          · simp [q, hr0]
          · have hp : fieldsTape ws ((r : ℤ) - 1) ≠ none := by
              intro hb
              exact fieldsTape_no_double_blank ws hws ((r : ℤ) - 1) (by omega)
                (by omega) ⟨hb, by simpa using hc⟩
            simp [q, hr0, hp]
        rw [hq]
        simp [seekEndTM, read _ r hr.le, hc]
      | some γ =>
        have hq : q = .run ∨ q = .gap := by
          dsimp [q]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        rcases hq with hq | hq <;> rw [hq] <;> simp [seekEndTM, read _ r hr.le, hc]
    have h := catalog_seek_step (seekEndTM k i) i d q
      (if fieldsTape ws r = none then .gap else .run) r .pos htr
    simpa [F, q, SignType.pos_eq_one,
      show ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = r by omega] using h
  have hexit : (seekEndTM k i).step (F L) = D := by
    have hs : (F L).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
      simp only [F]
      rw [read _ L le_rfl, endblank L (by omega)]
    have hstateF : (F L).state = some .gap := by
      simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, Nat.ne_of_gt hpos, endblank _ le_rfl]
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (seekEndTM k i) (F L) (q' := .done) 0 hstateF
      (by simp only [seekEndTM, hs]), moveInputPos_zero]
    rfl
  have hD : (seekEndTM k i).step D = D := by
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (seekEndTM k i) D 0 rfl rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
  have result := catalog_pass_contract (seekEndTM k i) F D L hF hexit hD
    (fun c => c.state ≠ some .done)
    (fun c => ∀ j : Fin k, if j = i then
      c.workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + L)
      else c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)
    (by intro r _; simp only [F, catalogSeekCfg]; split_ifs <;> simp)
    (by
      intro r hr j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      · simp [F, catalogSeekCfg, hj])
    (by
      intro j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [D, Finset.mem_Icc]
      · simp [D, hj])
  rw [h0] at result
  exact ⟨result.1, result.2.1, fun j t ht => result.2.2 t ht j⟩

/-- **R8.3, seek to the start of a table** (design §12.8a, decision O5). From
a nonblank cell, move the head of tape `i` left across blank-separated fields
until two consecutive blank cells, then return right to the first cell after
them. `run` crosses field cells, `gap` follows a single blank, a second blank
turns into `back`, and `back` steps right into `done`. Nothing is written. -/
def seekStartTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase where
  q₀ := .run
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .run =>
      match w i with
      | some _ => tapeAction i 0 none .neg .run
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .neg .gap
    | .gap =>
      match w i with
      | some _ => tapeAction i 0 none .neg .run
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .pos .back
    | .back => tapeAction i 0 none .pos .done
    | .done => inputMoveAction 0 .done

/-- **R8.3, seek to the start, framed** (design §12.8a). Let the head of tape
`i` be on a nonblank cell, preceded by a list `ws` of nonempty fields in the
field layout, each followed by its blank separator, so that the layout of `ws`
starts at `pos - D` with `D = fieldOffset ws |ws|`, and preceded in turn by two
blank cells. Then the seek reaches `done` at exactly `D + 4` and not earlier,
with the head of tape `i` at `pos - D`, the start of the table, and nothing
else changed. At `ws = []` the head is already at the start, and the run takes
`4` steps. The cells from `pos + 1` on and before `pos - D - 2` are arbitrary.
Up to the exit the head stays within `[pos - D - 2, pos]`, and every other
head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** The current cell is one left step in `run`. Then induct on
`ws` from its last field: its separator is one left step into `gap`, and each
of its cells one left step in `run`. The two blanks before the table are one
left step into `gap` and one right step into `back`, and `back` is one right
step into `done`. The left steps number `D + 2`. -/
theorem seekStartTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ [])
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hcur : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) ≠ none)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -2 ≤ p → p < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length + p) = fieldsTape ws p) :
    (seekStartTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧
      (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4,
        ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4 →
        if j = i then
          ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - fieldOffset ws ws.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
        else ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  classical
  let L := fieldOffset ws ws.length
  let phase := fun r : ℕ => if r = 0 then SeekPhase.run else
    if d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r + 1) = none then .gap else .run
  let F := fun r : ℕ => if r ≤ L + 2 then catalogSeekCfg i d (phase r) (-(r : ℤ))
    else catalogSeekCfg i d .back (-(L : ℤ) - 1)
  let D : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x := { d with
    state := some .done
    workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - L) }
  have first (hL : 0 < L) : fieldsTape ws 0 ≠ none := by
    cases ws with
    | nil => simp [L, fieldOffset] at hL
    | cons u us =>
      have hu : 0 < u.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (hws u (by simp))
      have h := fieldsTape_field (u :: us) 0 (by simp) 0 (by omega) (by simp)
      simp only [fieldOffset, List.take_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
        zero_add, List.getElem_cons_zero] at h
      rw [h]
      simp [FinTM.bufferTape, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hu]
  have blank (p : ℤ) (hp : p < 0) (hlo : -2 ≤ p) :
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - L + p) = none := by
    rw [hw p hlo (by omega)]
    simp [fieldsTape, show ¬0 ≤ p by omega]
  have noearly (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ L + 1) (hrpos : 0 < r) :
      ¬(d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r) = none ∧
        d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r + 1) = none) := by
    intro hb
    by_cases hr1 : r = 1
    · subst r
      exact hcur (by simpa using hb.2)
    have ht0 := hw ((L : ℤ) - r) (by omega) (by omega)
    have ht1 := hw ((L : ℤ) - r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show d.workTapePos i - L + ((L : ℤ) - r) = d.workTapePos i - r by omega] at ht0
    rw [show d.workTapePos i - L + ((L : ℤ) - r + 1) = d.workTapePos i - r + 1 by omega] at ht1
    have hb0 := ht0.symm.trans hb.1
    have hb1 := ht1.symm.trans hb.2
    by_cases he : r = L + 1
    · have hz : (L : ℤ) - r + 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [hz] at hb1
      exact first (by omega) hb1
    · exact fieldsTape_no_double_blank ws hws ((L : ℤ) - r) (by omega) (by omega) ⟨hb0, hb1⟩
  have read (q : SeekPhase) (r : ℕ) :
      (catalogSeekCfg i d q (-(r : ℤ))).workTapeSymbols i =
        d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r) := by
    simp [catalogSeekCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h0 : F 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [F, phase, catalogSeekCfg, hstate]
  have hF (r : ℕ) (hr : r < L + 3) : (seekStartTM k i).step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    by_cases hreg : r < L + 2
    · let q' : SeekPhase := if d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r) = none then .gap else .run
      have htr : (seekStartTM k i).tr (phase r) (catalogSeekCfg i d (phase r) (-(r : ℤ))).inputSymbol
          (catalogSeekCfg i d (phase r) (-(r : ℤ))).workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i 0 none .neg q' := by
        cases hc : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r) with
        | none =>
          have hq : phase r = .run := by
            by_cases hr0 : r = 0
            · simp [phase, hr0]
            · have hp : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - r + 1) ≠ none := by
                intro hp
                exact noearly r (by omega) (by omega) ⟨hc, hp⟩
              simp [phase, hr0, hp]
          rw [hq]
          simp [seekStartTM, read, hc, q']
        | some γ =>
          have hq : phase r = .run ∨ phase r = .gap := by
            dsimp [phase]
            split_ifs <;> simp
          rcases hq with hq | hq <;> rw [hq] <;> simp [seekStartTM, read, hc, q']
      have h := catalog_seek_step (seekStartTM k i) i d (phase r) q' (-(r : ℤ)) .neg htr
      have hz : -(r : ℤ) + (SignType.neg : ℤ) = -((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        simp [SignType.cast]
        omega
      rw [hz] at h
      have hp : phase (r + 1) = q' := by
        simp only [phase, show r + 1 ≠ 0 by omega, if_false]
        rw [show d.workTapePos i - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = d.workTapePos i - r by omega]
      simpa only [F, if_pos (show r ≤ L + 2 by omega),
        if_pos (show r + 1 ≤ L + 2 by omega), hp] using h
    · have he : r = L + 2 := by omega
      subst r
      have hphase : phase (L + 2) = .gap := by
        have hb := blank (-1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [show d.workTapePos i - L + (-1) = d.workTapePos i - ((L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 by omega] at hb
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hb
        simp [phase, hb]
      have hs : (catalogSeekCfg i d .gap (-((L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
        rw [read]
        have hb := blank (-2) (by omega) (by omega)
        convert hb using 1
        congr 1
        omega
      have h := catalog_seek_step (seekStartTM k i) i d .gap .back (-((L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) .pos
        (by simp only [seekStartTM, hs])
      have hz : -((L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (SignType.pos : ℤ) = -(L : ℤ) - 1 := by
        simp only [SignType.cast]
        omega
      rw [hz] at h
      simpa [F, hphase] using h
  have hexit : (seekStartTM k i).step (F (L + 3)) = D := by
    have h := catalog_seek_step (seekStartTM k i) i d .back .done (-(L : ℤ) - 1) .pos rfl
    simp only [F, show ¬L + 3 ≤ L + 2 by omega, if_false]
    rw [h]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [D, catalogSeekCfg, SignType.cast]
    congr 1
  have hD : (seekStartTM k i).step D = D := by
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (seekStartTM k i) D 0 rfl rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
  have result := catalog_pass_contract (seekStartTM k i) F D (L + 3) hF hexit hD
    (fun c => c.state ≠ some .done)
    (fun c => ∀ j : Fin k, if j = i then
      c.workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - L - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
      else c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)
    (by intro r _; dsimp [F]; split_ifs <;> simp [catalogSeekCfg, phase]; split_ifs <;> simp)
    (by
      intro r hr j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · dsimp [F]; split_ifs <;> simp [catalogSeekCfg, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega
      · simp only [if_neg hj]
        dsimp [F]
        split_ifs <;> simp [catalogSeekCfg, hj])
    (by
      intro j
      rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hj
      · simp [D, Finset.mem_Icc]
      · simp [D, hj])
  rw [h0] at result
  exact ⟨result.1, result.2.1, fun j t ht => result.2.2 t ht j⟩

/-! ### R8.2 — the two-pass scan (G2 core) -/

/-- **Left-to-right Mealy transduction** (design §12.8a, R8.2). Run the
finite-state transducer `δ` over `w` from state `a`: each cell is rewritten
by `δ`'s output and the state advances. Returns the final state and the
rewritten word. -/
def mealyRun {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) : A → List Γ → A × List Γ
  | a, [] => (a, [])
  | a, γ :: w =>
    let r := δ a γ
    let s := mealyRun δ r.1 w
    (s.1, r.2 :: s.2)

/-- Mealy runs split over an append (the per-cell step of both passes of the trace). -/
private theorem mealyRun_append {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List Γ) :
    mealyRun δ a (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ((mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).1,
        (mealyRun δ a l₁).2 ++ (mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).2) := by
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [mealyRun]
  | cons γ l ih => simp [mealyRun, ih]

/-- The structural induction used for Mealy invariants. Proof sketch: expose one
transducer step and pass its recursive result to the cons case. -/
private theorem mealyRun_induction {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ)
    (P : A → List Γ → A × List Γ → Prop)
    (hnil : ∀ a, P a [] (a, []))
    (hcons : ∀ a γ l r, P (δ a γ).1 l r → P a (γ :: l) (r.1, (δ a γ).2 :: r.2))
    (a : A) (l : List Γ) : P a l (mealyRun δ a l) := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact hnil a
  | cons γ l ih => exact hcons a γ l _ (ih (δ a γ).1)

/-- Mealy runs preserve length (the scan's rewritten interval is the word interval). -/
private theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) :
    (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length := by
  refine mealyRun_induction δ (fun _ w r => r.2.length = w.length)
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a l
  intro b γ w r hr
  exact congrArg Nat.succ hr

/-- Extending a Mealy prefix reads the next input cell and emits the corresponding
cell of the full output. Proof sketch: split the input at that cell and use append. -/
private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A)
    (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧
      (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) =
        (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 := by
  constructor
  · rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hr, mealyRun_append]
    rfl
  · have he : w = w.take r ++ w[r] :: w.drop (r + 1) := by
      rw [← List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hr, List.take_append_drop]
    have hl : (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).2.length = r := by
      rw [mealyRun_length, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hr.le]
    have hlookup : (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]? =
        some (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 := by
      rw [congrArg (mealyRun δ a) he, mealyRun_append]
      simp only [mealyRun]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
      simp only [hl, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_cons_zero]
    have hrout : r < (mealyRun δ a w).2.length := by
      simpa only [mealyRun_length] using hr
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrout] at hlookup
    exact Option.some.inj hlookup

/-- **The two-pass scan result** (design §12.8a, R8.2): transduce `w` left to
right by `δf` from `a₀`, then right to left by `δb` from the state the first
pass ends in. Returns the final state and the rewritten word, in its original
order. -/
def scanResult {A Γ : Type*} (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) : A × List Γ :=
  let f := mealyRun δf a₀ w
  let b := mealyRun δb f.1 f.2.reverse
  (b.1, b.2.reverse)

/-- **Phase alphabet of the scan** (design §12.8a, R8.2), each phase carrying
the transducer state: the forward pass, the backward pass, and the live exit
anchors, one per final state. -/
inductive ScanPhase (A : Type) where
  /-- the forward pass -/
  | fwd (a : A)
  /-- the backward pass -/
  | bwd (a : A)
  /-- the live exit anchors, one per final transducer state -/
  | done (a : A)
deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **R8.2, the two-pass transducer scan** (design §12.8a; the G2 core of the
§13d revision). Rewrite the delimited word under the head of tape `i` cell by
cell, left to right by `δf` and then back by `δb`, carrying a finite state
from `a₀`. The right delimiter turns the head, and the left delimiter steps
right into `done a` with the final state `a` as the verdict. Fold, in-place
map, head-mark shifts and carry odometers are instances
(`Turing.scanResult_fold` and its siblings). -/
def scanTM {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) :
    MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A) where
  q₀ := .fwd a₀
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .fwd a =>
      match w i with
      | some γ => tapeAction i 0 (some (some (δf a γ).2)) .pos (.fwd (δf a γ).1)
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .neg (.bwd a)
    | .bwd a =>
      match w i with
      | some γ => tapeAction i 0 (some (some (δb a γ).2)) .neg (.bwd (δb a γ).1)
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .pos (.done a)
    | .done a => inputMoveAction 0 (.done a)

/-- **R8.2, scan, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration in the
forward phase at `a₀` whose tape `i` carries the delimited word `w`, the scan
reaches `done` at exactly `2|w| + 2` and no `done` anchor earlier. At that
point the control state is `done` of the final state of
`Turing.scanResult δf δb a₀ w`, the word interval `[pos, pos + |w|)` holds its
rewritten word, and every other cell, the head positions, the input position
and the output are unchanged. Up to the exit the head of tape `i` stays within
`[pos - 1, pos + |w|]`, and every other head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** The `catalog_trace_run` skeleton, with the forward and
backward cell maps of the two Mealy passes in place of the sweeps'. Induct on
the cells for each pass: the forward pass takes `|w|` steps, writing
`mealyRun δf`'s outputs; the right delimiter turns the head in one step; the
backward pass takes `|w|` steps over the forward output in reverse, writing
`mealyRun δb`'s outputs; the left delimiter supplies the entry step. -/
theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k)
    (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀))
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1)
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  let f := mealyRun δf a₀ w
  let b := fun r => mealyRun δb f.1 (f.2.reverse.take (w.length - r))
  let F : ℕ → Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := fun r => { d with
    state := some (.fwd (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1)
    workTapes := fun j q =>
      if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (r : ℤ)
        then FinTM.bufferTape f.2 (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q
    workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }
  let R : ℕ → Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := fun r => { d with
    state := some (.bwd (b r).1)
    workTapes := fun j => if j = i then
      catalogTape (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) (f.2.take r ++ (b r).2.reverse)
      else d.workTapes j
    workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0 }
  let D : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := { d with
    state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1)
    workTapes := fun j q =>
      if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
        then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
        else d.workTapes j q }
  have fl : f.2.length = w.length := mealyRun_length δf a₀ w
  have ft : f.2.take w.length = f.2 := List.take_of_length_le (by omega)
  have bl (r : ℕ) : (b r).2.length = w.length - r := by
    simp [b, mealyRun_length, fl]
  have wl (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ w.length) :
      (f.2.take r ++ (b r).2.reverse).length = w.length := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_take, List.length_reverse, bl, fl,
      Nat.min_eq_left hr]
    omega
  have h0 : F 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [F, mealyRun, hstate]
    funext j q
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  have hF (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
      (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    have hs : (F r).workTapeSymbols i = some w[r] := by
      simp only [F, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, true_and]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa only [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr] using
        hw r (by omega) (by omega)
    have hn := mealyRun_next δf a₀ w r hr
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_write (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (F r)
      (q' := .fwd (δf (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1) i 0
      (some (δf (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2) .pos rfl
      (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp only [F, hn.1]
    · simp [F]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        have ht := catalog_write_take (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i) f.2 r
          (by simpa only [fl] using hr)
        simpa only [F, Function.update_self, ↓reduceIte, true_and, f, hn.2] using ht
      · simp [F, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, SignType.pos_eq_one]
        omega
      · simp [F, hj]
    · rfl
  have hturn : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (F w.length) = R w.length := by
    have hs : (F w.length).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
      simp only [F, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, true_and]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa using hw w.length (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (F w.length)
      (q := .fwd f.1) (q' := .bwd f.1) i 0 .neg
      (by simp [F, f]) (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [R, b, mealyRun]
    · simp [F, R]
    · funext j q
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, R, b, mealyRun, catalogTape, fl, ft]
      · simp [F, R, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, R, SignType.cast, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]
      · simp [F, R, hj]
    · rfl
  have hR (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
      (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (R (r + 1)) = R r := by
    have hrout : r < f.2.length := by omega
    have hb : b r = ((δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).1,
        (b (r + 1)).2 ++ [(δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2]) := by
      have hi : w.length - (r + 1) < f.2.reverse.length := by simp only [List.length_reverse]; omega
      have he : f.2.reverse[w.length - (r + 1)] = f.2[r] := by
        rw [List.getElem_reverse]
        congr 1
        omega
      have hn : w.length - r = (w.length - (r + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      change mealyRun δb f.1 (f.2.reverse.take (w.length - r)) = _
      rw [hn, List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi, mealyRun_append]
      simp only [he, mealyRun]
      rfl
    have hword : f.2.take (r + 1) ++ (b (r + 1)).2.reverse =
        f.2.take r ++ f.2[r] :: (b (r + 1)).2.reverse := by
      rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hrout, List.append_assoc]
      rfl
    have hl : (f.2.take r).length = r := by simp [fl, Nat.min_eq_left hr.le]
    have hs : (R (r + 1)).workTapeSymbols i = some f.2[r] := by
      simp only [R, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [show d.workTapePos i + (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = d.workTapePos i + r by omega]
      unfold catalogTape
      rw [wl (r + 1) (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [show d.workTapePos i + (r : ℤ) - d.workTapePos i = r by omega,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat, hword, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
      simp [hl]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_write (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (R (r + 1))
      (q' := .bwd (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).1) i 0
      (some (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2) .neg rfl
      (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [R, hb]
    · simp [R]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        have ht := catalog_write_middle (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i)
          (f.2.take r) (b (r + 1)).2.reverse f.2[r] (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2
        simpa only [R, Function.update_self, ↓reduceIte, hword, hl, hb,
          List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append,
          List.singleton_append,
          show d.workTapePos i + (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = d.workTapePos i + r by omega]
          using ht
      · simp [R, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, SignType.cast]
        omega
      · simp [R, hj]
    · rfl
  have hentry : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (R 0) = D := by
    have hb0 : b 0 = mealyRun δb f.1 f.2.reverse := by
      dsimp [b]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp [fl])]
    have result : scanResult δf δb a₀ w = ((b 0).1, (b 0).2.reverse) := by
      rw [hb0]
      rfl
    have hs : (R 0).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
      simp only [R, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, catalogTape]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hw (-1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (R 0)
      (q' := .done (b 0).1) i 0 .pos rfl (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [D, result]
    · simp [R, D]
    · funext j q
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, D, catalogTape, result, bl]
      · simp [R, D, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, D, SignType.pos_eq_one]
      · simp [R, D, hj]
    · rfl
  have hD : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step D = D := by
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) D 0 rfl rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
  have trace (t : ℕ) : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace F R D w.length t := by
    rw [← h0]
    exact catalog_trace_run _ F R D _ hF hturn hR hentry hD t
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [trace]
    simp [catalogTrace, show ¬2 * w.length + 2 ≤ w.length by omega, D]
  · intro t ht a
    rw [trace]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [F, R]
    omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [trace]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [F, R, D, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega

/-! ### The scan's instances -/

/-- **The identity step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and the cell.
As the backward step, it makes a scan a single forward pass plus a return. -/
def scanKeep {A Γ : Type*} : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (a, γ)

/-- **The fold step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): update the state by `δ` and keep
the cell. -/
def scanFold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (δ a γ, γ)

/-- **The map step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and rewrite the cell
by `f`. -/
def scanMap {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (a, f γ)

/-- **The delay step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): read the mark `get γ` of the
cell into the state, and write the previous mark into the cell by `set`. As
the forward step it shifts the marks one cell right; as the backward step,
one cell left. -/
def scanShift {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) : B → Γ → B × Γ :=
  fun b γ => (get γ, set γ b)

/-- **The carry step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): with the carry set, advance the
digit by `next` and keep the carry exactly when the digit was the top one
(`top`), which wraps; with the carry clear, keep the digit. -/
def scanCarry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) : Bool → Γ → Bool × Γ :=
  fun c γ => if c then (top γ, next γ) else (false, γ)

/-- The identity step transduces nothing. -/
private theorem mealyRun_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a : A) (l : List Γ) : mealyRun scanKeep a l = (a, l) := by
  refine mealyRun_induction scanKeep (fun b w r => r = (b, w))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a l
  intro b γ w r hr
  cases hr
  rfl

/-- With the identity return, a scan is its forward pass (four of the five identities
reduce to a `mealyRun` induction through this). -/
private theorem scanResult_keep {A Γ : Type*} (δf : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult δf scanKeep a₀ w = mealyRun δf a₀ w := by
  simp [scanResult, mealyRun_keep]

/-- The one list identity `scanResult_shiftLeft` needs beyond `scanResult_shiftRight`:
the right shift of the reversed word, reversed back, is the left shift. -/
private theorem shiftLeft_list {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    (List.zipWith set w.reverse (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get)).reverse =
      List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀]) := by
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w =>
    -- the reversed right shift reads one mark too many; `zipWith` drops it
    have h1 : List.zipWith set (a :: w).reverse (b₀ :: (a :: w).reverse.map get) =
        List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) := by
      have h := List.zipWith_append (f := set) (l₁ := w.reverse ++ [a]) (l₁' := [])
        (l₂ := b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) (l₂' := [get a]) (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, List.zipWith_nil_left] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp
    -- both lists now have length `|w| + 1`, so reversal commutes with `zipWith`
    have h2 : List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) =
        (List.zipWith set (a :: w) (w.map get ++ [b₀])).reverse := by
      rw [List.reverse_zipWith (by simp)]
      simp
    rw [h1, h2, List.reverse_reverse]
    rfl

/-- Once the carry clears, every subsequent cell and the clear flag stay unchanged. -/
private theorem mealyRun_carry_clear {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ)
    (w : List Γ) : mealyRun (scanCarry top next) false w = (false, w) := by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih => simp [mealyRun, scanCarry, ih]

/-- **Scan instance, fold** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the fold step
and the identity return computes `w.foldl δ a₀` and leaves the word intact.
With `Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg`, the fold's verdict is `done (w.foldl δ a₀)` at
exactly `2|w| + 2`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and induct on `w`: the forward pass is
`(w.foldl δ a₀, w)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/
theorem scanResult_fold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (w.foldl δ a₀, w) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  refine mealyRun_induction (scanFold δ) (fun b l r => r = (l.foldl δ b, l))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a₀ w
  intro b γ l r hr
  simp only [scanFold, List.foldl_cons, hr]

/-- **Scan instance, in-place map** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the map
step and the identity return rewrites the word to `w.map f`, with the state
unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and apply the shared Mealy induction: the forward
pass is `(a₀, w.map f)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/
theorem scanResult_map {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w.map f) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  refine mealyRun_induction (scanMap f) (fun b l r => r = (b, l.map f))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a₀ w
  intro b γ l r hr
  simp only [scanMap, List.map_cons, hr]

/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift right** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the delay step forward and the identity return writes into cell `j` the mark
of cell `j - 1`, and `b₀` into cell `0`. The final state is the mark of the
last cell, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `b₀` and induct on `w`: the first cell receives
`b₀`, and the tail is the shift of the tail from the first cell's mark. -/
theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: w.map get)) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  induction w generalizing b₀ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih =>
    simp only [mealyRun, scanShift, ih, List.map_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons,
      List.getLast?_cons, Option.getD_some]

/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift left** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the identity forward pass and the delay step backward writes into cell `j`
the mark of cell `j + 1`, and `b₀` into the last cell. The final state is the
mark of cell `0`, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** The forward pass is `(b₀, w)`. The backward pass is the
right shift of `w.reverse` from `b₀`, by the induction of
`Turing.scanResult_shiftRight`; reversing it gives the left shift. -/
theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀])) := by
  have h := scanResult_shiftRight get set b₀ w.reverse
  rw [scanResult_keep] at h
  simp only [scanResult, mealyRun_keep, h]
  rw [shiftLeft_list]
  simp only [List.map_reverse, List.getLast?_reverse]

/-- **Scan instance, carry odometer** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the
carry step from a set carry, with the identity return, is the little-endian
increment of a digit word: every top digit of the maximal top prefix wraps by
`next`, the first other digit advances by `next`, and the rest is kept. The
final carry is set exactly when every digit was top, that is, on overflow.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `w`. A top first digit wraps and passes the carry
to the tail; any other first digit advances and clears the carry, after which
the carry step is the identity. -/
theorem scanResult_carry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
      (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++
        (w.dropWhile top).drop 1) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih =>
    cases ht : top γ <;>
      simp [mealyRun, scanCarry, ht, mealyRun_carry_clear, ih]

end Turing
```

```
/-

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Convention
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: wrappers

The output-isolation layer of the machine-construction library
(`machine-library-design.md` §5, W1–W3): the capture/silence discipline
written once, consolidating its four private incarnations
(`universalCaptureTM` in the universal-machine development, the Chapter-2
enumerator's `enumCaptureTM`, the HALT batch's `acceptTM`, and the private
engine inside `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition.exists_cond`).
The obligation list is the one the phase-1 and phase-4 audits tabulated:
every source emission is captured, **including an emission on the halting
transition**; the wrapper's physical output stays untouched; the completed
source configuration is preserved at the return.

**Status: proved.** The two action/configuration transformers and the
derived machine are real definitions; the four contract theorems are
proved (filled from the existing private proofs in the library fill
batches; gates closed). New Chapter-1 surface, audited in the shared
infrastructure round.

## Design

* **W1 (capture)** is *host-parametric*: rather than a closed wrapper
  machine, `Turing.captureAction` transforms one source action into a host
  action (source tapes untouched, emission appended to the last tape,
  silence, halt redirected to a designated return state), and
  `Turing.capture_run` says that **any** host machine agreeing with the
  transformed table on an embedded copy of the source states simulates the
  source in lockstep with its output captured on the last tape. Consumers
  (the loop fill, HALT-style control modifications, the Chapter-2
  continuations) embed the source into *their* controller state type and
  inherit the whole induction. The capture tape holds the full output
  word (tape-capture core, frozen design decision 9.3); reading one bit
  off it is the register corollary, derived at fill time.
* **W2 (halt-redirect)** is the `acceptTM` pattern as a closed
  transformation `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM`: simulate a machine silently
  while remembering the last emitted bit, halt exactly when the source
  halts with the designated bit, and otherwise enter a one-state
  stationary live loop.
* **W3 (timed branch)** is the quantitative form of
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial`'s sibling
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`: deciding which branch runs costs the
  decider's budget, and the branch runs on the *same* physical input, so
  no monotonicity hypothesis is needed.

## Main declarations

* `Turing.captureAction`, `Turing.captureCfg` — the W1 transformers.
* `Turing.capture_run` — the W1 lockstep/capture/silence contract.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` — the W2 transformation.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_computes`, `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_live` — the
  W2 contract pair.
* `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond` — the W3 timed branch.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2; the capture discipline is the
  output-isolation folklore every simulation argument of §1.4–§1.7 uses.)

**Implementation note (batch W).** All four contracts are now proved; the
original spec-phase descriptions above and in their docstrings are retained.
The conditional controller instantiates `capture_run` on a padded decider,
reads its singleton output, and uses a quantitative refinement of
`rewind_from_any`. Its branch-start prefix is at most twice the decider's
budget plus five, yielding the uniform multiplier `5` in the frozen bound.

**Maintainer note (D6 promotion).** Batch W's two shared-lemma promotion
requests are executed: `timed_input_bound` is now the public
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound` in `Deterministic.lean` (generalized
from `Bool` to an arbitrary symbol type; the proof was symbol-free), and
`timed_rewind` is the public `Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind` in
`Simulation.lean`, verbatim. The private copies formerly here are removed;
the two call sites below consume the public lemmas.

**Implementation note (emitter batch W).** `emit_run` is now proved by the
private action identity `emit_apply` and the guarded induction used by
`capture_run`. A halting action forwards its optional final emission on
the same transition that transfers control to the live return state.
-/

namespace Turing

variable {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*}

/-- W1 action transformer. Transform one source action into a host action
over one extra tape: the source's input move and work-tape actions are kept
on the first `k` tapes; the source's emission, **if any**, is written on
the last tape with a right move (so the capture tape accumulates the output
word from the origin); the host emits nothing; a live source successor is
embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action transfers control to the
designated return state `ret` — on the very transition that may carry the
final emission, which is therefore captured like any other. -/
def captureAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action (k + 1) Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else
      match a.output with
      | some b => (some (some b), SignType.pos)
      | none => (none, SignType.zero)
  output := none
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- W1 configuration correspondence. A source configuration `c`, viewed
inside a host with one extra tape: source state embedded (a halted source
sits at the return state `ret`), same input head, source work tapes on the
first `k` tapes, and the capture tape holding `pre ++ c.output` — the
emissions captured so far after a pre-existing prefix — with its head one
past that word. The host's own physical output is the untouched `out₀`. -/
def captureCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg (k + 1) Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ c.output)
  workTapePos := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapePos ⟨i, h⟩
    else ((pre ++ c.output).length : ℤ)
  output := out₀

/-- Applying a captured action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission to the buffer. The write uses the old head before moving.
**Proof sketch.** Split the tape index at the source tape count. Source tapes
are unchanged by the embedding; on the final tape use `bufferTape_append`
for an emission and the stationary no-write action otherwise. -/
private lemma capture_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (captureAction emb ret a).apply (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho,
          ← List.append_assoc, FinTM.bufferTape_append]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho, Nat.cast_add,
          add_assoc]
  · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply]

/-- **W1, the capture contract** (harvested from the
four private incarnations). If a host machine's transition table agrees, on
an embedded copy of the source's states, with the capture-transformed
source table, then the host run from a capture configuration *is* the
capture image of the source run, for as long as the source has not halted
before the time in question. Taking `t` to be the source's halting time
instantiates the return clause: the host sits at `ret` with the completed
source configuration preserved, the full source output (halting emission
included) on the capture tape, and the host output still `out₀`; taking
`t` below it gives live lockstep.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `t`. One host step from a live capture image
applies the transformed action: the first `k` tapes and the input head
update exactly as the source's (`Turing.Action.apply` componentwise); the
capture tape appends the emitted bit, which is
`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append` at head `|pre ++ c.output|`; silence keeps
the host output at `out₀`; and the successor state is the embedded source
successor, or `ret` on the halting transition. -/
theorem capture_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
        captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [captureCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (fun i => (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapeSymbols
          i.castSucc) = c.workTapeSymbols := by
        funext i
        simp [captureCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, i.isLt]
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact capture_apply emb ret pre out₀ c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

/-- **E2 action transformer** (design §11): the forwarding dual
of `Turing.captureAction`. Transform one source action into a host action
over the **same** tapes: input move and work-tape actions are kept
verbatim; the source's emission, **if any, is forwarded as the host's
physical emission** — including an emission on the halting transition; a
live source successor is embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action
transfers control to the designated live return state `ret`. This is what
lets a proved transducer serve as one emission stage of a larger host.
Customers: the forwarding loop-host variant behind `exists_emitLoopTM`,
and `exists_emitCallTM`'s module. Construction: a record map, no
machine content. -/
def emitAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action k Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := a.workTapes
  output := a.output
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- **E2 configuration correspondence** (design §11): a source
configuration `c`, viewed inside the host — state embedded (a halted source
appears at the live return state `ret`), tapes, heads, and input position
verbatim, and the host's physical output equal to the host's prior output
`pre` followed by everything the source has emitted. It deliberately does
**not** normalize the source's terminal tapes or heads: clean returns are
the separate bridge contracts' job (`exists_installCallTM`,
`exists_emitCallTM` — emitter-infra round-1 audit, finding 1). Customers:
`emit_run`'s statement and the bridge fills. Construction: a record map,
no machine content. -/
def emitCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg k Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := c.workTapes
  workTapePos := c.workTapePos
  output := pre ++ c.output

/-- Applying a forwarded action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission after the host prefix, including when that action halts.
**Proof sketch.** The state, input head, work tapes, and work heads agree
definitionally; the physical output equality is append associativity. -/
private lemma emit_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (emitAction emb ret a).apply (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
  exact List.append_assoc pre c.output a.output.toList

/-- **E2, the forwarding wrapper** (design §11;
customers: the emitting loop's per-round chunk calls, the Cook-Levin
clause-group emission (4A), 3B-cont's fresh-literal chains). Any host
machine agreeing with the transformed table on an embedded copy of the
source states runs the source in lockstep while **appending the source's
output to the host's physical output**, the exact dual of
`Turing.capture_run`: source tapes verbatim, the halting transition's
emission forwarded like any other, and the host landing in the live
return state at the source's halt.

**Construction sketch.** Mirror `capture_run`: one `emitAction`-apply
lemma (source fields preserved; the optional emission appended to the
host output after `pre`), then induction over the guarded run, the guard
supplying a genuine source step including at the final halt. -/
theorem emit_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin k → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w = emitAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp w))
    (pre : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (emitCfg emb ret pre c₀) t =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
        emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [emitCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact emit_apply emb ret pre c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

end Turing

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- W2 transformation: the `acceptTM` control-modification pattern. Simulate
`M` with its output suppressed while a finite register remembers the **last**
emitted bit (`none` before any emission) — updated *before* the halt test, so
a bit emitted on the halting transition counts. When the source halts, halt
if the remembered bit is `haltOn`; otherwise enter the one-state stationary
live loop. Tape count unchanged. -/
def redirectTM (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k
  State := (M.State × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit
  tm :=
    { q₀ := Sum.inl (M.tm.q₀, none)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        match q with
        | Sum.inl (s, r) =>
          let a := M.tm.tr s inp work
          let r' := match a.output with
            | some b => some b
            | none => r
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := a.workTapes
            output := none
            state := match a.state with
              | some s' => some (Sum.inl (s', r'))
              | none => if r' = some haltOn then none else some (Sum.inr ()) }
        | Sum.inr () =>
          { inputTape := SignType.zero
            workTapes := fun _ => (none, SignType.zero)
            output := none
            state := some (Sum.inr ()) } }

/-- Map a source state and its last-emission register to simulation, halt,
or the stationary live loop. An empty register never matches a bit. -/
private def redirectState {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool) (q : Option S)
    (r : Option Bool) : Option ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  match q with
  | some s => some (.inl (s, r))
  | none => if r = some haltOn then none else some (.inr ())

/-- Suppress physical emission, updating the register before the halt test. -/
private def redirectAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool)
    (a : Action k Bool S) (r : Option Bool) : Action k Bool ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, none, redirectState haltOn a.state (a.output.or r)⟩

/-- The source tapes and input head are unchanged; its last emitted bit is
remembered in control and the physical output is empty. -/
private def redirectCfg (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool
      (redirectTM M haltOn).State x :=
  ⟨redirectState haltOn c.state c.output.getLast?, c.inputPos,
    c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, []⟩

/-- The stationary live loop is fixed by every subsequent transition. -/
private lemma redirect_loop (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool (redirectTM M haltOn).State x)
    (hs : c.state = some (.inr ())) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom c t = c := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, redirectTM, Action.apply]

/-- Capture and application commute because the last entry of an appended
singleton is the new bit, while no emission leaves the old register intact. -/
private lemma redirect_apply (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : Action M.k Bool M.State) :
    (redirectAction haltOn a c.output.getLast?).apply (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (a.apply c) := by
  have hlast : (c.output ++ a.output.toList).getLast? = a.output.or c.output.getLast? := by
    cases a.output <;> simp
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ rfl rfl rfl rfl
  dsimp only [redirectCfg, redirectAction, Action.apply]
  rw [hlast]

/-- The correspondence also holds after a source halt: a matching result
is absorbed as halted, and a mismatching result is absorbed in the live loop.
This adapts `acceptCfg_step` in the HALT reduction to an optional register. -/
private lemma redirect_step (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.step (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.step c) := by
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hs]
    by_cases hr : c.output.getLast? = some haltOn
    · exact MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr])
    · exact redirect_loop M haltOn (redirectCfg M haltOn c)
        (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr]) 1
  | some q =>
    have hi : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
    have hstate : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).state = some (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?)) := by
      simp only [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    rw [hi, hw]
    have htr : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.tr (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?))
        c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
        redirectAction haltOn (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c.output.getLast? := by
      cases hq : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state <;>
        cases ho : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output <;>
          simp [redirectTM, redirectAction, redirectState, hq, ho]
    rw [htr]
    exact redirect_apply M haltOn c _

/-- Initialized runs commute with redirection at every time, including
after a source halt. This is the last-emission invariant for both clauses. -/
private lemma redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) := by
  have hi : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x = redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.initCfg x) := rfl
  rw [hi]
  exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (redirectCfg M haltOn) (redirect_step M haltOn)
    (M.tm.initCfg x) t

/-- **W2, the halting clause** (harvested from the
HALT batch's `acceptTM_halts_iff`). If `M` completes output `w` on `x`
within `t` steps and the last bit of `w` is the designated bit, the
redirected machine halts on `x` within the same budget with **empty**
output (everything was suppressed).

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep correspondence between `M`'s run and the
redirected run, carrying "register = last emitted bit so far"; at `M`'s
halting transition the register equals `w`'s last bit, so the redirect
halts there. -/
theorem redirectTM_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? = some haltOn) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).ComputesInTime x [] t := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hout⟩ := (computesInTime_iff M x w t).mp hM
  apply (computesInTime_iff _ x [] t).mpr
  rw [redirect_run]
  exact ⟨by simp only [redirectCfg, hs, hout, redirectState, hlast, ite_true], rfl⟩

/-- **W2, the live clause**. If `M` completes output
`w` on `x` and `w`'s last bit is *not* the designated bit (in particular if
`w = []`), the redirected machine never halts on `x`: at the source's
halting transition it enters the stationary live loop, which is fixed under
every further step.

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep with the register invariant (register = last
emission so far) up to the source's halting transition; there the register
differs from the designated bit, so control enters the stationary live
state, which every further step fixes (two-line induction). -/
theorem redirectTM_live {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? ≠ some haltOn) :
    ∀ u : ℕ, ¬((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) u).Halted := by
  intro u hhalt
  rw [redirect_run] at hhalt
  change redirectState haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output.getLast? = none at hhalt
  -- A redirected halt forces a genuine source halt with the matching register.
  have hs : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state = none := by
    cases h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state with
    | none => rfl
    | some q => simp only [redirectState, h, reduceCtorEq] at hhalt
  have hc : M.ComputesInTime x (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output u :=
    (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have hout := hc.output_unique hM
  rw [hs, hout] at hhalt
  simp only [redirectState, if_neg hlast, Option.some_ne_none] at hhalt

/-- Pad the decider with the fresh branch tapes. The added tapes are idle,
so the public left-block simulation supplies its complete run invariant. -/
private def timedPadTM (D : FinTM Bool) (r : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (D.k + r) Bool D.State where
  q₀ := D.tm.q₀
  tr q inp work := leftAction r id (D.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd r i)))

/-- The conditional controller captures the decider on the last tape,
steps back to read its singleton verdict, rewinds the physical input, then
runs the selected branch on its untouched tape bank. In the administrative
states, the first Boolean distinguishes back/read and the second distinguishes
rewind-start/scan. The branch transition table is independent of its selector. -/
private def timedCondTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1
  State := D.State ⊕ (Bool ⊕ ((Bool × Bool) ⊕ (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State)))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl D.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl q => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false))
            ((timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)).tr q inp (fun i => work i.castSucc))
        | .inr (.inl false) =>
          ⟨0, (fun i => if (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k) then (none, 0)
            else (none, .neg)), none, some (.inr (.inl true))⟩
        | .inr (.inl true) => controlAction 0
            (some (.inr (.inr (.inl ((work (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))) =>
            controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))) => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
          | none => controlAction .pos
              (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => leftAction 1 id
            (rightAction D.k (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s)))
              ((branchTM M₁ M₂ false).tm.tr q inp
                (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc))) }

/-- The branch configuration retains the decider's finished work and the
captured verdict; its own state, input head, work tapes, and output are exact. -/
private def timedBranchCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  leftCfg id (rightCfg (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))) c tapes heads)
    (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)

/-- The decider's configuration inside its padded, captured simulation.
Both branch tape banks are blank throughout this phase. -/
private def timedControlCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  captureCfg Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun (_ : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k)) _ => none) (fun _ => 0))

/-- The capture contract, instantiated on the padded decider, gives the
entire controller phase through its first halt. -/
private lemma timed_capture (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ s < t, ¬(D.tm.runFrom c s).Halted) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t) := by
  have hpad (u : ℕ) := leftCfg_run D.tm (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) id
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) u
  have h := capture_run (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)) t (fun s hs => by
      unfold Cfg.Halted
      rw [hpad s]
      simpa only [leftCfg, Option.map_id] using hlive s hs)
  simpa only [hpad t] using h

/-- The host's genuine initial configuration is the captured, padded
initial configuration: all three work-tape blocks are blank. -/
private lemma timed_control_init (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.initCfg x) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]

/-- Once dispatched, the selected branch runs in lockstep while the old
decider tapes and singleton capture tape remain idle.
**Proof sketch.** The branch action is a right-block embedding followed by
a left-block embedding; compose their application lemmas, then iterate. -/
private lemma timed_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b) t =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads b := by
  apply MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (fun c => timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b)
  intro d
  cases hs : d.state with
  | none =>
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_none]
  | some q =>
    have hstate : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).state =
        some (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) := by
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_some, id_eq]
    have hi : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).inputSymbol = d.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc) = d.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext i
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.castSucc, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    dsimp only [timedCondTM]
    let emb : (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) → (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State :=
      fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))
    change (leftAction 1 id (rightAction D.k emb
      ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.tr q d.inputSymbol
        (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc)))).apply
        (leftCfg id (rightCfg emb d tapes heads)
          (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)) = _
    erw [hw, leftCfg_apply, rightCfg_apply]
    rfl

/-- After reading the verdict, all branch data are initialized; only the
input head still needs rewinding. The capture head is back at cell zero. -/
private def timedReadyCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  { timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b with
    state := some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))))
    inputPos := c.inputPos }

/-- Two silent transitions move the capture head left and read the completed
singleton verdict, without touching the input or either work bank.
**Proof sketch.** The final capture head is one past the singleton, hence at
one. Moving it left exposes exactly its bit at zero; the next transition
records that bit in the rewind state. -/
private lemma timed_read (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) 2 =
      timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b := by
  let ready := timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b
  have hback : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) =
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} := by
    have hstate : (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).state = some (.inr (.inl false)) := by
      simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ rfl
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
  have hread : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} = ready := by
    have hsym : ({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _) = some b := by
      change (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)
        c.workTapes c.workTapePos b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (0 : Fin 1)) = some b
      simp [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, bufferTape]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    dsimp only
    change ((controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr (.inl
      ((({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))) :
          Action (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State).apply _ = _
    rw [hsym, controlAction_apply]
    simp only [Option.getD_some, moveInputPos_zero]
    rfl
  change (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
    ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c)) = _
  rw [hback, hread]

/-- A singleton-output decider reaches the selected branch's genuine
initial configuration in at most twice its budget plus five steps.
**Proof sketch.** Choose the first source halt, which is within the supplied
budget. Capture until that halt, read the singleton in two steps, and rewind
in at most the current input position plus two. The head-position bound
charges this rewind to the decider's elapsed steps, not the input length. -/
private lemma timed_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads b := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none :=
    ⟨T, ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hD).1⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  let c := D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hD).1
  have hs : c.state = none := Nat.find_spec hh
  have hc : D.ComputesInTime x c.output t := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have ho : c.output = [b] := hc.output_unique hD
  have hcap : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c := by
    rw [timed_control_init]
    exact timed_capture D M₁ M₂ _ t (fun s hst => Nat.find_min hh hst)
  obtain ⟨r, hrle, hr⟩ := timed_rewind (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false)))) (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))))
    (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl)
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b) rfl
  refine ⟨t + 2 + r, ?_, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, ?_⟩
  · have hp : c.inputPos.val ≤ 1 + t := by
      simpa only [MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, Fin.val_one] using
        MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound (tm := D.tm) (D.tm.initCfg x) t
    change r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2 at hrle
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap,
      timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho, hr]
    rfl

/-- **W3, the timed branch**: the quantitative form of
`Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`. If a decider machine computes the test bit
within `T₀` and each branch computes its function within `T₁`, `T₂`, the
conditional function is computable within a constant multiple of
`T₀ + max T₁ T₂ + 1`. No monotonicity hypothesis: the selected branch runs
on the *same* physical input.

**Proof sketch.** Run the decider through the W1 capture discipline (its
verdict on the capture tape, physical output silent), rewind per the
`Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any` scan, then dispatch on the captured bit into
the two-machine branch union (`Turing.FinTM.branchTM`), which runs the
selected branch from its genuine initial configuration on the shared input.
Constant overhead per phase is absorbed into `c`. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_cond {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) := by
  refine ⟨timedCondTM D M₁ M₂, 5, fun x => ?_⟩
  let B := max (T₁ x.length) (T₂ x.length)
  have hb : (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) B := by
    apply (branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x _ B).mpr
    cases hp : p x with
    | false => exact (h₂ x).mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
    | true => exact (h₁ x).mono (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, tapes, heads, hstart⟩ :=
    timed_start D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (T₀ x.length) (hD x)
  have hc : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (a + B) := by
    apply (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart, timed_branch_run]
    obtain ⟨hs, ho⟩ := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hb
    exact ⟨by simpa only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hs, ho⟩
  -- The controller prefix and selected branch fit one uniform coefficient.
  apply hc.mono
  dsimp only [B] at *
  omega

end Turing.FinTM
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulation.lean =====

```
/-
